Quicksilver Steel.hab: Made in alchemists' foundries from steel and quicksilver drawn from red cinnabar beds near hot springs. The air there is thick with toxic fumes.
Quicksilver Steel.how: Alloy steel with stabilised mercury over days in a sealed forge, wearing masks against poison fumes. One slip can kill the smith. Store ingots dry.

Runic Lodestone.hab: Dark grey stone with natural rune marks in the bedrock under ancient rune-carving sites, where words of power were spoken for ages. Compasses swing toward it.
Runic Lodestone.how: Quarry with picks and wedges, cutting around the runes without breaking them. A few days of careful work. Store apart from iron, which it draws.

Shadowglass.hab: Black glass formed from compressed shadow in the grey plane of shadow, often near cold lakes and ruins where all colour fades. Light dies quickly there.
Shadowglass.how: Travel into the shadow plane with magical light and chip glass free with a silver hammer. Shadows attack the living. Wrap in black velvet.

Shadowsteel.hab: Dark metal ore in mines of the grey plane of shadow, and in hoards guarded by wraiths. The tunnels are cold and silent, swallowing every sound.
Shadowsteel.how: Mine in near darkness with silvered picks, guarding against wraiths. Weeks of grim work. Store in light-proof, cloth-wrapped crates.

Starmetal.hab: Heavy iron from meteorites buried under old impact craters and in deposits drifting in the astral sea. The rock around it is fused and dark.
Starmetal.how: Dig out the meteorite with picks over days, or gather astral deposits with nets from a ship. Smelt in a very hot forge. Store dry.

Stormstone.hab: Crackling stone on hilltops and towers struck by lightning again and again, often bare ridges in stormy country. Hair stands on end nearby.
Stormstone.how: Quarry between storms with wooden-handled tools and rubber or leather gloves, as it shocks bare skin. Store in insulated boxes away from iron.

Thundercrystal.hab: Humming crystals on high mountain peaks struck by constant lightning, often near the summits. The air smells of storms and crackles all day.
Thundercrystal.how: Climb in calm weather with ropes and chip crystals free; lightning and falls are the main dangers. Store padded in boxes; they hum loudly.

Veinstone.hab: Stone with glowing, pulsing mineral veins deep in the earth near ley lines. The glow can be seen in dark caves far below the surface.
Veinstone.how: Dig deep shafts and quarry with steel picks over a week, following the glowing veins. Cave-ins are a risk. Store in padded crates.

Warstone.hab: Red crystals on ancient battlefields soaked with battle magic, buried among old weapons and bones. The ground is scarred and still feels tense.
Warstone.how: Dig up crystals from the battlefield over a few days; restless spirits and old traps may attack. Store in iron-banded boxes.

Wyrmwood.hab: Trees in forests where dragons have nested for centuries, scorched, frozen or warped by dragon breath. The bark shows the dragon's colour.
Wyrmwood.how: Fell with an axe only when the dragons are away; a returning dragon is deadly. The wood resists ordinary fire. Season for months.

Ahead Stone.hab: Arrow-shaped grey veins under old roadsides and crossroads of the Mysterious realm, where the Ahead Rune pools in bedrock. Signposts nearby all lean the same way.
Ahead Stone.how: Dig in the direction it points with pick and lamp, never walking backward in the tunnel or the vein shifts away. A day's work; carry it in a sheath.

Asymmetry Stone.hab: Lopsided black-and-white veins in Mysterious caves where no two walls match, where the Asymmetry Rune pools. Tunnels bend unevenly and footing is uneven.
Asymmetry Stone.how: Cut it with two different tools, one for each half; using one tool splits it. A day of awkward work. Store in an odd-shaped padded box.

Boomstone.hab: Dark crackling veins in Mysterious caves prone to rockfalls, where the Boom Rune pools. Loose rock, small pops and dust falling from the ceiling warn of a seam.
Boomstone.how: Chip very gently with soft hammers and prop tunnels with timber; a hard strike makes it explode. Slow work over two days. Store in straw-packed crates.

Boreas Stone.hab: Icy blue-white veins in northern passes of the Mysterious realm where winter winds never stop, where the Boreas Rune pools. Frost and blasting cold mark the spot.
Boreas Stone.how: Mine in furs and goggles, as the stone blasts freezing air once uncovered. A day of bitter work. Seal it in a lidded iron box.

Bronzestone.hab: Warm brown-gold veins in Mysterious hills near ancient smelting sites, where the Bronze Rune pools. Old slag heaps and green-stained rock show the way.
Bronzestone.how: Dig with bronze tools over a day; it is soft and easily scarred by iron picks. Wrap each stone in cloth and pack in sawdust.

Condensestone.hab: Tiny, very heavy stones in Mysterious caves where everything is packed tightly, where the Condense Rune pools. Tunnels are cramped and the air feels thick.
Condensestone.how: Work in tight tunnels with short picks and strong levers; a fingernail-size stone can weigh as much as a sack of grain. Carry in an iron box.

Convergence Stone.hab: Spiral-lined veins under Mysterious valleys where rivers meet, where the Convergence Rune pools. Paths, streams and animal trails all lead to the same spot.
Convergence Stone.how: Dig down at the meeting point with pick and pump, as water seeps into the shaft. A day or two. Store in a round wooden case.

Creepstone.hab: Green-black veins in damp, overgrown Mysterious caves, where the Creep Rune pools. Moss and stains slowly spread across the walls near a seam.
Creepstone.how: Mine with gloves and disposable wooden tools, as its stain spreads to anything it touches. A day's work. Store in sealed glass jars.

Culturestone.hab: Banded, many-coloured veins under ancient settlements of the Mysterious realm, where the Culture Rune pools. Old pottery and foundations lie above the seam.
Culturestone.how: Dig carefully through the old ruins, layer by layer, with a trowel and brush over two days. Breaking bands spoils it. Store in padded boxes.

Despairstone.hab: Cold, colourless veins in forgotten pits of the Mysterious realm, where the Despair Rune pools. Light dims and hope fades as you descend.
Despairstone.how: Mine in short shifts with bright lanterns and cheerful company, as long work brings deep despair. A day or two. Store in a sealed box.

Ether Stone.hab: Misty grey stone from the border of the ghostly plane, found where the material world thins. Ghostly figures drift around it.
Ether Stone.how: Reach the border by ritual or magic and chip off stone while it is solid. Ghosts may be hostile. Store in a warded box to keep it stable.

Existencestone.hab: Plain grey veins in Mysterious bedrock where the Existence Rune pools. The stone is impossible to ignore, drawing every eye in the tunnel.
Existencestone.how: Mine with pick and chisel over a day; the hard part is not getting distracted by staring. Store in a plain box.

Faultstone.hab: Cracked, rust-coloured veins under Mysterious scrap heaps, where the Malfunction Rune pools. Tools and machines nearby break down or jam.
Faultstone.how: Dig with spare tools, since picks snap and lamps fail near it. A day or two of frustrating work. Store in a padded box; it clicks randomly.

Hastestone.hab: Streaky orange veins in Mysterious canyons scoured by fast winds, where the Haste Rune pools. Everything nearby seems slightly blurred.
Hastestone.how: Grab it quickly with gloves as it vibrates and slips. A half day of fast work. Store in a tight leather pouch.

Hihiirokane.hab: Sun-red metal deep in the roots of old shrines at the spirit edge, where spirits sleep. The ground above stays warm even in winter.
Hihiirokane.how: Dig after a shrine ritual and with priest permission, using wooden tools to avoid angering spirits. A week of careful work. Store in a sacred cloth.

Hupiastone.hab: Dark crimson veins in Mysterious caves where blood-drinkers roost, where the Hupia Rune pools. The cave smells of blood and bats cluster above.
Hupiastone.how: Mine during the day while blood-drinkers sleep, with garlic and stakes at hand. Two days of work. Store in a sealed red box.

Infinatas Stone.hab: Pearly white veins beneath Mysterious shrines of the old god, where the Infinatas Rune pools. Shapes of half-made things shimmer in the stone.
Infinatas Stone.how: Mine only with the shrine keepers' blessing, using fine chisels over two days. Disrespect brings the old god's anger. Store in silk.

Innovationstone.hab: Odd-shaped, colour-shifting veins under Mysterious workshops and abandoned laboratories, where the Innovation Rune pools. Strange half-built devices lie around.
Innovationstone.how: Dig carefully among old experiments, as some still work or explode. A day or two of work. Store in a padded box; it fits no setting.

Intellect Stone.hab: Deep blue veins with silver lines under Mysterious libraries buried by time, where the Int Rune pools. Old books and scrolls lie in the dirt above.
Intellect Stone.how: Dig through the buried library with brushes and trowels over days, saving the old books. Store in a velvet-lined case.

Linestone.hab: Long, straight-grooved veins in Mysterious cliffs, where the Line Rune pools. The rock splits in perfect straight lines that always face the same way.
Linestone.how: Cut along the grooves with chisel and rope work on cliffs, a day's labour. Breaking a line ruins it. Store laid flat in a long box.

Magma Crystal.hab: Glowing crystals in volcanic cores with elemental activity, where fire and earth meet. The heat is extreme and elementals roam.
Magma Crystal.how: Mine with fire protection and heavy tongs over days; heat and elementals are the dangers. Store in thick clay-lined iron boxes.

Maskstone.hab: Pale featureless veins in Mysterious caves, where the Mask Rune pools. The stone reflects faces that are never quite your own.
Maskstone.how: Mine with a cloth over your face, as staring makes you lose track of who you are. A day's work. Wrap in plain linen.

Mirrorite.hab: Made by alchemical synthesis from mirror sand and silver in sealed alchemist's laboratories. The finished metal shows only its surroundings.
Mirrorite.how: Synthesise over a week with silver, mirror sand and reagents. Divination cannot find it, so it is easily lost. Store in a labelled box.

Movestone.hab: Small rounded veins under Mysterious streambeds, where the Move Rune pools. Stones in the stream shift position when no one watches.
Movestone.how: Dig while keeping an eye on it the whole time, or it rolls away. A half day of work. Store in a locked box.

Notus Stone.hab: Damp grey-green veins in Mysterious bedrock, where the Notus Rune pools. A soft autumn wind and constant damp mark the spot.
Notus Stone.how: Mine in autumn with pick and chisel over a day, wearing oilskins. Store in a waxed box, as it stays wet.

Physicalstone.hab: Dense, warm veins in Mysterious bedrock, where the Physical Rune pools. The stone flexes slightly like muscle when struck.
Physicalstone.how: Mine with heavy picks and strong arms over a long day; it is very heavy. Store in a sturdy box.

Prismatic Tourmaline.hab: Colour-cycling tourmaline in magical crystal caverns deep underground, where colours flicker across the walls. The air hums with magic.
Prismatic Tourmaline.how: Mine during calm moments with crystal picks over days; colour shifts can burn or freeze. Store in warded pouches.

Runegold.hab: Made from gold dug in rune-marked seams, then smelted and cast with runic inscription at every stage. The best gold comes from hills of old rune circles.
Runegold.how: Mine the gold, then smelt with a runesmith carving runes at every step. Weeks of skilled work. Store in a warded vault.

Serenitystone.hab: Pale lavender veins under Mysterious mountain shrines and silent lakeshores, where the Serenity Rune pools. Everything nearby is perfectly calm.
Serenitystone.how: Mine in silence and calm; anger cracks the stone. A day's careful work. Store in a soft cloth.

Skeletonstone.hab: Bone-white, porous veins under Mysterious ossuaries and graveyards where bones lie near the surface, where the Skeleton Rune pools.
Skeletonstone.how: Dig through the bones with respect and a priest's blessing; skeletons may rise. A day or two. Store in a bone box.

Skymetal.hab: Light, hard metal from meteorites buried in Mysterious meteor craters. The crater rock is glassy and faintly glowing.
Skymetal.how: Dig out meteorites with picks over days, then smelt in a hot forge. Already saturated with power, it resists enchanting. Store dry.

Soulsteel.hab: Made by compressing soul energy into metal through soul binding, in hidden forges of necromancers. The forges are cold and haunted.
Soulsteel.how: Requires soul binding rituals over weeks, which is dangerous and often evil. Spirits may resist. Store in warded iron.

Spiritsteel.hab: Steel dissolved into the astral plane and reformed in spirit-forges there. The forges float in the silver void and glow softly.
Spiritsteel.how: Travel astrally to a spirit-forge and reform steel over days. Psychic storms are dangerous. Store in cloth-lined crates.

Sylphstone.hab: Nearly weightless veins in high crags and cliffside nests, where the Sylph Rune pools. Stones drift slightly in the wind.
Sylphstone.how: Climb with ropes and mine with care, as stones float off. A day's work. Store in a weighted box.

Symmetrystone.hab: Perfectly mirrored crystal veins in strange Mysterious caves, where the Symmetry Rune pools. Tunnels and formations mirror each other exactly.
Symmetrystone.how: Cut both halves at once with matched tools over a day; uneven cuts ruin it. Store in a matched box.

Tempostone.hab: Banded, pulsing veins in caverns that echo with rhythm, where the Tempo Rune pools. A slow drumbeat sounds through the rock.
Tempostone.how: Mine in time with its beat, striking only on the pulse. A day of rhythmic work. Store in a padded drum case.

Thistlewing Seed.hab: Huge downy thistle seeds drifting upward from the fey highlands, carried against the wind. They gather on high ridges and windy peaks.
Thistlewing Seed.how: Catch them with a fine net on windy days, which can take hours. Store in a closed jar or they float away.

Thunderpearl.hab: Charged pearls in oysters on ocean reefs struck by lightning again and again. The water sparks and crackles in storms.
Thunderpearl.how: Dive between storms and pry open oysters with insulated knives; shocks and drowning are dangers. Store in insulated boxes.

Twilight Amber.hab: Amber found where fey pockets meet dusk, in twilight glades and gateways. Time seems to slow near it.
Twilight Amber.how: Gather at dusk with gloves and a slow, calm hand; rushing makes it vanish. Store in a dark box.

Vortexstone.hab: Grey spiral veins deep in wind-scoured Mysterious cliffs, where the Vortex Rune's power pools; the rock hums and loose dust circles slowly above a buried seam.
Vortexstone.how: Dig a braced shaft toward the humming, then chisel the vein over two days while gusts whip the tunnel; lash each piece into weighted canvas so it cannot spin away.

Zombiestone.hab: Greyish-green veins under old shallow graves in the Mysterious realm, where the Zombie Rune's power pools; turf above sinks and smells of decay, and bones turn up near the seam.
Zombiestone.how: Sink a narrow shaft beside the graves and pick the soft vein out over two days; expect restless dead, wear a cloth mask, and pack it in salt-lined boxes.

Astral Dust.hab: Drifts in the Deep Astral of the Mysterious realm, settling in silver eddies around floating rock and dead thought-currents far from any shore; it glints and blinks in and out.
Astral Dust.how: Sweep it with a fine silk net during a long astral voyage, often weeks; seal it in lead-stoppered vials at once, or it blinks away to somewhere else.

Chronomancy Shard.hab: Grows where time magic was used or time broke, at temporal anomalies in the Mysterious realm; candles there burn backward, echoes come early, and shards hang frozen mid-fall.
Chronomancy Shard.how: Step into the anomaly with an hourglass to track the loop and pluck the shard with gloved tongs between repeats; lingering ages or unages the gatherer, so work fast.

Dreaming Poppy.hab: Violet poppies in the sleeping fields of the fey courts, where the air is heavy with pollen, sleepers lie in the grass, and no one remembers how they arrived.
Dreaming Poppy.how: Cut the heads with a silver sickle while holding a waking charm or a bitter herb under the tongue; dry them in sealed jars, as their scent drags sleepers into dream.

Negative Energy Crystal.hab: Black crystals that form on the edges of the Negative Energy Plane, reached through the darkest corners of the Mysterious realm, where light dies and living things wither to dust.
Negative Energy Crystal.how: Only with strong necrotic wards and a lead-lined box; break the crystal free with a long iron pole in minutes, as every moment drains life from the collector.

Orichalcum.hab: Reddish-gold metal that only appears in the divine forges hidden in the Mysterious realm, cooling in the slag troughs beside anvils tended by unseen godly smiths.
Orichalcum.how: Earn or steal entry to a divine forge and lift the cooling pours with blessed tongs; the keepers guard every ingot, and a theft brings divine wrath.

Philosopher's Quicksilver.hab: Not found in nature; it comes from advanced alchemy, mercury taken through the full philosopher's process in Mysterious realm laboratories over months of careful heating and rest.
Philosopher's Quicksilver.how: Distil ordinary mercury through a sealed athanor for many months under a master alchemist's eye; one wrong temperature spoils the batch. Store in a stoppered glass flask.

Storm Elemental Spark.hab: The crystallised spark left when a storm elemental is broken in the Mysterious realm's thunder-lands, found glowing in scorched craters after violent storms fade.
Storm Elemental Spark.how: Defeat or outlast a storm elemental, then scoop the spark into a charged crystal cage with insulated gloves; grounded to bare earth, it discharges and is lost.

All domain gems.hab: Not one deposit but a set: each domain gem forms in a different sacred or hidden vault of the Mysterious realm, guarded by the domain it belongs to.
All domain gems.how: Months of travel to gather each gem from its own shrine or deep vault, by bargain, quest or deep mining; keep them apart in velvet so they do not quarrel.

All domain gems — one of each.hab: A full matched set, one gem from every domain, each born in its own guarded shrine or deep vault scattered across the far reaches of the Mysterious realm.
All domain gems — one of each.how: A long campaign: win, buy or mine each domain gem in turn, often over many months; store each in a separate warded pouch, since a missing one voids the set.

Ashstone.hab: Common grey stone found almost everywhere in Hell, forming plains and low cliffs under the fall of ash; it is warm, dull, and never cracks in the heat.
Ashstone.how: Quarry it with a pick and wedges in an afternoon; wear a damp cloth over the mouth against ash dust. It needs no special storage.

Brimstone.hab: Yellow sulphur crystal crusting the mouths of volcanic vents across Hell, thickest where yellow smoke rises and the ground is hot and stinking.
Brimstone.how: Knock crystals loose with a hammer and a long iron bar in an hour; breathe through a wet cloth, and keep it away from open flame.

Brimstone Nettle.hab: Yellow nettles in the ash wastes of Hell's outer circles, growing in sparse clumps on grey drifts; the air near them smells faintly of struck matches.
Brimstone Nettle.how: Cut with shears while wearing thick leather gloves and sleeves, since stings leave sulphur burns; bundle the stalks and dry them in the shade for a day.

Cinder Moss.hab: Dark red moss on the crust of cooling lava fields in Hell, spreading where the rock is still warm underfoot and faint embers glow in its fronds.
Cinder Moss.how: Scrape it off with a flat iron spatula in a few minutes; wear thick boots on the hot crust, and store it in a tin so it does not smoulder.

Brimstone Ingot.hab: Smelted from sulphur-rich brimstone ore that lies in shallow seams beneath Hell's ash fields, where the soil is yellowed and the rock smells of burning.
Brimstone Ingot.how: Mine the yellow ore with a pick over a day, then smelt it in a stone furnace into ingots; work with good airflow, as the fumes choke.

Ember Iron.hab: Red-hearted iron seams under the ash fields of Hell's outer circles, close to the surface; the ash above stays warm and sometimes glows at night.
Ember Iron.how: Dig it with an iron pick in a day, handling chunks with tongs and heavy gloves, since the core smoulders forever; carry it in a metal bucket.

Liquid Fire.hab: Made by alchemical synthesis in Hell's workshops, mixing infernal oils and sulphur under sealed glass; it never occurs naturally because it ignites on contact with air.
Liquid Fire.how: Brew it over a day in an airtight still, then decant under oil into sealed clay flasks; one crack or spilled drop sets the workshop ablaze.

Sanguine Copper.hab: Made, not found: ordinary copper put through a blood alchemy process in Hell's ritual workshops, where the metal soaks up life energy over several nights.
Sanguine Copper.how: Steep copper ingots in fresh blood under a ritual circle for three nights, tending the brazier; the work tires the alchemist. Wrap the ingots in red cloth.

Sinner's Thorn.hab: Black briars in the prison hedges of Hell, growing thickest around cells and cages that hold the guilty; their thorns lengthen near anyone with a crime to hide.
Sinner's Thorn.how: Snip lengths with iron shears while wearing thick gloves; guards may object, and the briars snag the guilty. Bind cuttings with wire in a dry sack.

Sulfur Crystal.hab: Yellow crystal clusters around steaming vents in Hell, forming in the crusted rims where hot gas escapes and the ground hisses.
Sulfur Crystal.how: Pry clusters free with a bronze chisel in an hour, standing upwind of the vent; wrap them in cloth and keep away from flame.

Blood Magic Carnelian.hab: Red-orange stones at Hell's sacrificial sites and blood ritual circles, forming in the soil where shed blood crystallised; the ground around them stays faintly warm.
Blood Magic Carnelian.how: Dig carefully into the stained soil with a small trowel over a few hours; cultists may guard the circle. Store in a warm, dry pouch.

Bloodthorn.hab: Dark red thorny shrubs in Hell's punishment gardens, rooted in blood-soaked soil beside whipping posts and racks, where tormented souls water them with suffering.
Bloodthorn.how: Cut the canes with a hooked knife while gloved; the thorns drink blood from any scratch. Collect under a guard's nose, and dry them hanging upside down.

Brimstone Iron.hab: Common iron ore in the mines of Hell's fiend realms, lying in deep sulphur-yellow seams warmed by fires below; miners know it by its burning smell.
Brimstone Iron.how: Pick it out of the seam over a full day in a hot shaft; take water and a breathing cloth. Carry the ore in iron carts.

Cinderbloom.hab: Ember flowers on the lava-lit cliffs of Hell, clinging to ledges above flowing magma where hot updrafts keep their petals glowing.
Cinderbloom.how: Climb with rope and heat-proof gloves, then snip the bloom into a warm clay pot of coals; cool air makes it wilt within minutes.

Infernal Brass.hab: Forged brass from the Nine Hells, made in deep infernal foundries where devils have worked it in hellfire for centuries; never found raw in the ground.
Infernal Brass.how: Buy or barter from devil smiths, or raid a foundry; any deal carries a price. Carry the brass in a fireproof case, since its edges cut.

Bloodiron.hab: Dark red iron in the soil of ancient battlefields in Hell, soaked by countless deaths; the ground there is rust-colored and still warm in places.
Bloodiron.how: Dig shallow pits with a spade and pick for a day, sifting broken blades and ore; restless spirits may rise. Keep it wrapped in linen.

Bloodsteel.hab: Crimson steel made in Hell's torture-pit foundries, quenched in the blood of the damned; it pools in casting trenches beside the pits.
Bloodsteel.how: Enter a guarded foundry and lift ingots from the quench trenches with tongs; it drinks blood from any cut. Store in an oiled leather case.

Hellglass.hab: Clear red-black glass on Hell's lava shores, formed where molten rock meets cooler ground; it lies in sheets that crack and ring in the heat.
Hellglass.how: Break off pieces with a hammer and thick gloves, staying clear of the lava's edge; one splash kills. Wrap each shard in wool.

Infernal Brimstone.hab: Crystallised brimstone lumps in the hottest, most wicked corners of the Nine Hells, where hellfire cools; they gather at the edges of burning pits and smoking vents.
Infernal Brimstone.how: Pry lumps from the pit edge with a long iron bar in an hour or two; the heat is extreme, so wear fire wards. Carry in a stone box.

Bloodfire Ruby.hab: Deep red rubies in the throats of Hell's active volcanoes near ley lines, embedded in hot rock walls where lava and magic meet underground.
Bloodfire Ruby.how: Descend a volcanic tunnel with fire wards and chisel the ruby out over several hours; eruptions are a constant danger. Store it in a fireproof pouch.

Charred Heartwood.hab: The black core of burned god-trees in Hell, found inside ancient stumps on scorched hills where the trees still smoulder from within.
Charred Heartwood.how: Split the stump with an axe and wedge over a full day to reach the heartwood; it is still hot. Wrap in wet hides and keep dry afterward.

Hellforged Iron.hab: Iron worked in Hell's hellfire forges and quenched in brimstone, held in devil-run armouries; every piece is bound to a devil's contract.
Hellforged Iron.how: Gained only by signing a devil's contract or stealing from an armoury; either carries a cost. Keep it in a locked iron chest.

Penance Iron.hab: Heavy grey iron in the chain-quarries of Hell's judgment circles, where seams run under prison yards worked by condemned souls.
Penance Iron.how: Dig with a heavy pick over two days, working beside prisoners; the ore grows heavier for anyone carrying guilt. Haul it in a cart.

Wailing Ore.hab: Ore deep in Hell's prison mines, in seams that scream faintly when struck; the deeper tunnels echo with endless wailing.
Wailing Ore.how: Mine it with a pick and wax earplugs over two days; the screams cause dread and despair. Wrap ore in thick felt to muffle it.

Wrathroot.hab: Gnarled red roots under the battlefields of Hell's wrath circle, sprouting where furious souls fought; the soil above steams and cracks when anyone shouts.
Wrathroot.how: Dig them out with a spade and calm mind over an hour; anger makes them steam and burn. Store in a cool clay jar.

Abyssal Bronze.hab: Bronze corrupted by demonic energy, found in demon hoards in the deep places of Hell that border the Abyss; it weeps a thin acid in cave pools.
Abyssal Bronze.how: Raid a demon hoard and lift the bronze with acid-proof gloves; demons will fight for it. Store it in a glass-lined box.

Ashlily.hab: Grey lilies in the burnt-out ruins of Hell, blooming only in fresh ash after a fire; the air nearby smells strangely of rain.
Ashlily.how: Pick it with bare fingers within a day of the fire, before it closes; avoid crushing the petals. Keep it in a dry paper fold.

Blackflame Oil.hab: Black oil in deep pits in Hell, pooling under crusted tar where black, cold flames flicker over the surface.
Blackflame Oil.how: Ladle it with a long iron dipper into a sealed clay jar over an hour; its cold flames burn the skin. Keep the jar stoppered and cool.

Crimsonite.hab: Blood-red crystals at sites of mass sacrifice in Hell, growing from the ground where many died; nearby plants wither and creatures feel weak.
Crimsonite.how: Chip it free with a silver chisel in an hour while warded against life drain; staying long saps strength. Store in a lead-lined pouch.

Magma Pearl.hab: Glowing pearls that form in Hell's lava lakes, rolling slowly in the molten rock near the shores and gathering in cooler eddies.
Magma Pearl.how: Fish them out with a long iron ladle while warded against fire, over many hours; a fall into the lake is fatal. Keep in a fireproof box.

Sinbrass.hab: Gleaming brass seams in the vaults beneath Hell's infernal counting-houses, where it swells and brightens near greed; guarded by devil clerks.
Sinbrass.how: Dig carefully through a vault floor over two days, avoiding greedy thoughts that make it swell; theft triggers infernal contracts. Store in a locked chest.

Always Stone.hab: Black veins in Hell's oldest unchanging cliffs where the Always Rune's power pools; the rock never warms or cools, and the cliff face never weathers.
Always Stone.how: Dig a shaft into the cliff and chisel the vein over three days with diamond-edged tools; it does not crack easily. Carry it in canvas sacks.

Apocalypse Stone.hab: Cracked four-colored veins in Hell's deepest scorched pits where the Apocalypse Rune's power pools; the rock is warm and the air is heavy with dread.
Apocalypse Stone.how: Sink a shaft into the pit and break the vein free over two days; fires and collapses are common. Pack the stone in ash-filled crates.

Balance Stone.hab: Round black-and-white stones in Hell's still caverns where the Balance Rune's power pools; they rest without rolling, even on slopes.
Balance Stone.how: Dig a shaft into the caverns and lift each stone with both hands evenly over a day; tilting it cracks it. Carry in padded crates.

Bindstone.hab: Dark corded veins in Hell's twisted caverns where the Bind Rune's power pools; roots and chains grow together across the walls.
Bindstone.how: Cut through roots and chains with an axe and saw, then chisel the vein over two days; the chains may grab tools. Bind finished stone in rope.

Bloomstone.hab: Pink and gold flower-shaped stones in Hell's strange gardens where the Bloom Rune's power pools; blossoms grow from the burning soil above the vein.
Bloomstone.how: Dig beneath the flowers with a spade and chisel over two days; burning soil scorches hands. Store each stone in a padded box.

Bonestone.hab: Pale porous veins in Hell's ossuary caverns where the Bones Rune's power pools; the dead lie stacked in layers on either side of the seam.
Bonestone.how: Shaft through the ossuary and chisel the vein over two days without disturbing the dead; restless bones may rise. Wrap it in linen.

Bowstring Stone.hab: Clusters of thin curved stones in Hell's archery cliffs where the Bows Rune's power pools; many bow-like shapes gather in the same seam.
Bowstring Stone.how: Dig a shaft into the cliff and pry the cluster free whole over two days; snapping a single bow ruins it. Bind with cord and pad well.

Camouflage Stone.hab: Shifting veins in Hell's jungles where the Camouflage Rune's power pools; the stone blends into its surroundings, and predators lurk unseen nearby.
Camouflage Stone.how: Find the vein by touch, since sight fails, then dig a shaft over two days while watching for hidden beasts. Mark it with paint before storing.

Conformstone.hab: Veins in Hell's forge caverns where the Conform Rune's power pools; the stone reshapes to match whatever it presses against.
Conformstone.how: Dig a shaft into the forge caverns and cut the vein over two days with smooth tools, or it takes their shape. Store it in a smooth mould.

Craftstone.hab: Regular tool-marked veins in Hell's abandoned forges where the Man-Made Rune's power pools; the rock looks hammered and cut straight from the ground.
Craftstone.how: Dig beneath the forge floor and chisel the vein free over two days; old traps and forge-spirits may linger. Carry in wooden crates.

Darkstone.hab: Deep black veins in Hell's lightless trenches where the Dark Rune's power pools; nearby light dims and the stone is cold as still water.
Darkstone.how: Work by touch or darkvision, since torches fail near it; chisel it free over two days. Store wrapped in black cloth.

Decaystone.hab: Soft brown veins under Hell's rotting bogs where the Decay Rune's power pools; the stone flakes at its edges but never wears away.
Decaystone.how: Drain the bog and dig a shaft over three days; rot and foul gases are constant. Keep the stone in sealed jars.

Dimensionstone.hab: Purple veins in Hell's folded caverns where the Dimension Rune's power pools; tunnels loop back and the stone looks deeper than its size.
Dimensionstone.how: Map the folded tunnels with chalk, then chisel the vein over two days; it is easy to get lost. Store it in a padded box.

Doublestone.hab: Twin-halved stones in Hell's mirrored caves where the Double Rune's power pools; they always come in pairs and reflect each other perfectly.
Doublestone.how: Dig both halves free at the same time over two days; taking one alone shatters the pair. Store them together in one box.

Driftstone.hab: Light pitted gray veins under the loose plains of Hell where the Drift Rune's power pools; loose stones creep slowly across the ground above.
Driftstone.how: Dig a shaft and chisel the vein over two days; loose pieces wander off. Pin each stone with a peg or keep it in a lidded box.

Emberstone.hab: Stone formed from lava cooled fast with magic fire residue, found along Hell's active volcanic flows where fresh black crust forms over glowing rock.
Emberstone.how: Break off fresh crust with a hammer and iron bar while warded against heat, over an hour; molten rock lies beneath. Carry in a stone box.

Endstone.hab: Blunt dark red veins at the edges of Hell where the End Rune's power pools; the land stops abruptly, and the seam ends like a closed door.
Endstone.how: Dig a shaft near the edge and chisel the vein over two days; collapse into nothing is a real risk. Store in iron crates.

Erosionstone.hab: Smooth worn brown veins in Hell's canyons and riverbeds where the Erosion Rune's power pools; flowing water shapes the stone into smooth curves.
Erosionstone.how: Dam the riverbed and dig a shaft over two days; floods can return. Keep the stone dry in waxed sacks.

Evolvestone.hab: Layered veins in Hell's shifting caverns where the Evolve Rune's power pools; the stone and tunnel walls look slightly different each time they are seen.
Evolvestone.how: Chisel the vein over three days while sketching it to track its changes; it may grow or shrink. Store in a large box.

Freshstone.hab: Dewy green-white veins near rare cool springs within Hell where the Fresh Rune's power pools; the air smells of morning grass.
Freshstone.how: Dig a shaft beside the spring and chisel the vein over two days; demons covet the cool water. Keep the stone in a damp cloth.

Futurestone.hab: Pale smoky veins in quiet Hell caverns where the Future Rune's power pools; echoes sound before the noises that cause them.
Futurestone.how: Work slowly over two days, listening to the early echoes to avoid falls; visions distract. Store wrapped in grey cloth.

Griefstone.hab: Ashen grey veins beneath the burned remains of old pyres in Hell where the Grief Rune's power pools; tear-like streaks mark the stone.
Griefstone.how: Dig beneath the pyre ashes over two days; sorrow weighs on the diggers. Keep the stone in a dark cloth.

Grim Reaper Stone.hab: Curved black veins in Hell where countless deaths gathered, where the Grim Reaper Rune's power pools; pale marks on the stone count the dead.
Grim Reaper Stone.how: Sink a shaft over three days while warded against death magic; the stone draws restless dead. Store wrapped in black cloth.

Imprisonstone.hab: Dark iron-grey veins beneath Hell's old prisons and sealed vaults where the Imprison Rune's power pools; raised ridges on the stone look like chains.
Imprisonstone.how: Break into a vault and dig a shaft over three days; the stone can trap careless hands. Keep it in a locked box.

Indirectstone.hab: Crooked grey veins in Hell's winding caverns where the Indirect Rune's power pools; the stone bends light away from where it should go.
Indirectstone.how: Navigate the twisting tunnels with a rope line and chisel the vein over two days; sight misleads. Store in a padded box.

Ironstone.hab: Heavy rust-dark veins in Hell's deep mines where the Iron Rune's power pools; the stone clangs when struck and pulls on iron tools.
Ironstone.how: Use bronze or stone tools, since iron gets stuck to it, and chisel over two days. Carry in wooden carts.

Knockstone.hab: Rough blunt grey veins in Hell's battered caves and smashed gates where the Knocking Rune's power pools; the stone thuds loudly when tapped.
Knockstone.how: Dig a shaft and chisel the vein over two days; every strike booms and attracts attention. Pad the stone in thick felt.

Ledgerfern.hab: Ferns in the archives of Hell's counting circle, growing between shelves of infernal ledgers where the veins of each frond form columns of tiny numbers.
Ledgerfern.how: Clip fronds with fine scissors when archive keepers are not watching; theft triggers infernal audits. Press flat between parchment sheets.

Legacystone.hab: Dull bronze veins in Hell's old tomb-veins where the Legacy Rune's power pools; faint names nobody carved appear on the stone.
Legacystone.how: Dig a shaft through tomb walls and chisel the vein over two days; tomb guardians may wake. Store in a wooden box.

Nickstone.hab: Razor-edged veins in Hell where the Nick Rune's power pools; thin blades of stone scored with countless tiny cuts line the walls.
Nickstone.how: Wear thick gloves and chisel over two days; the stone always draws a little blood. Wrap each piece in leather.

Nightstone.hab: Deep indigo veins in Hell's lightless caverns where the Night Rune's power pools; silver flecks glint faintly and the air is always cold.
Nightstone.how: Work only by darkvision or dim lamplight over two days; the stone swallows light. Store wrapped in black velvet.

Oldstone.hab: Crumbling grey veins in ancient parts of Hell where the Old Rune's power pools; the stone is worn smooth by ages and sheds dust constantly.
Oldstone.how: Chisel it very gently over three days, as it crumbles easily; dust fills the air. Store it in padded boxes.

Pactstone.hab: Red-black veins in Hell where the Pacts Rune's power pools; faint signatures on the stone shift whenever someone makes a promise nearby.
Pactstone.how: Dig over two days and make no promises near it, or they bind you; devils may claim it. Store in a sealed box.

Painstone.hab: Raw flayed-looking veins in Hell where the Pain Rune's power pools; the stone burns with dull red warmth and stings when touched.
Painstone.how: Chisel it over two days wearing thick gloves; every touch stings. Wrap in layers of cloth before carrying.

Presentstone.hab: Clear glass-like veins in Hell where the Present Rune's power pools; the stone shows only the exact moment it is looked at.
Presentstone.how: Chisel carefully over two days, focusing on the present; distraction makes tools slip. Store in a padded box.

Projectile Stone.hab: Dense iron-grey veins under Hell's launching fields where the Projectile Rune's power pools; streaks in the stone point one way and it tugs forward.
Projectile Stone.how: Dig over two days, keeping the streaks pointed into the wall; loose stones fly. Store it in heavy crates, pointed down.

Ransomstone.hab: Dull gold hollow-centred veins in Hell's vaults and tollhouses where the Ransom Rune's power pools, buried under sealed debts.
Ransomstone.how: Dig through vault floors over two days; never place anything in the hollow, or it grips it. Store in a locked chest.

Rebirthstone.hab: Green and grey veins in Hell's underground gardens where the Rebirth Rune's power pools; seeds sprout in darkness and the stone sheds old skin.
Rebirthstone.how: Dig beneath the gardens over two days, without crushing sprouts; the stone sheds as it is carried. Store in moist moss.

Regeneration Stone.hab: Soft green veins in Hell's fungus caverns where the Regeneration Rune's power pools; severed roots and broken chips regrow overnight.
Regeneration Stone.how: Chisel it out over two days; chips grow back if left. Store in a lidded box, or it fills the space.

Remainstone.hab: Heavy dark grey veins in Hell's quiet catacombs where the Remain Rune's power pools; stones hold doors and coffins exactly shut.
Remainstone.how: Dig over three days using levers and pulleys, since set stones refuse to move; never set it down mid-carry. Haul in a cart.

Resurrection Stone.hab: Pale gold dark-cored veins in Hell's deepest tombs where the Resurrection Rune's power pools; life and death blur at the seam.
Resurrection Stone.how: Descend into the tombs and chisel over three days; the dead may stir. Store wrapped in white linen.

Rotstone.hab: Mottled green-black veins under Hell's swamps where the Rot Rune's power pools; every plant nearby has withered into slime.
Rotstone.how: Drain the swamp and dig over three days; the rot spreads to tools and skin. Store in sealed jars.

Shadestone.hab: Dark nearly weightless veins in Hell's twilight forests where the Shade Rune's power pools; the stone throws no shadow, and light never fully reaches the ground.
Shadestone.how: Dig over two days under the trees; light stones float away. Keep each piece in a weighted box.

Shockstone.hab: Jagged yellow-white veins in Hell's storm caverns where the Shock Rune's power pools; static builds in the stale air and sparks snap.
Shockstone.how: Wear insulated gloves and use wooden tools, chiselling over two days; shocks stun. Store in a glass box.

Sometime Stone.hab: Flickering veins in Hell's unstable caverns where the Sometime Rune's power pools; the caverns themselves appear only on certain nights.
Sometime Stone.how: Wait for the right night, then dig fast before the cavern fades; being trapped inside is deadly. Store in a lidded box.

Styx Water.hab: Dark water from the River Styx, which runs along Hell's borders with the lower planes; its banks are grey and silent, and memories fade near it.
Styx Water.how: Fill a lead-sealed flask with a long ladle, never touching the water; a splash erases memory. Guardians and ferrymen watch the banks.

Tradestone.hab: Copper and brass flecked veins beneath markets and trading posts along Hell's trade roads where the Trade Rune's power pools.
Tradestone.how: Dig beneath market floors over two days, buying the right first; theft is punished. Store in a locked strongbox.

Wallstone.hab: Heavy square-cut veins in Hell's ancient ramparts where the Wall Rune's power pools; the stone lies in layered courses like a built wall.
Wallstone.how: Quarry it in blocks over three days with heavy tools; collapses are common. Haul in reinforced carts.

Whitestone.hab: Pure white veins in Hell's pale, bleached caverns where the White Rune's power pools; the stone stays clean of stain and reflects every light.
Whitestone.how: Chisel it over two days with clean tools; dirty tools leave no mark. Store wrapped in white linen.

Abyssal Obsidian.hab: Shifting obsidian from the Abyss, found in Hell's deepest chaotic rifts where pure evil and chaos melt rock and the shards keep changing shape.
Abyssal Obsidian.how: Hold shards still with a binding charm, then break them free over hours; chaotic effects strike the careless. Store in a warded iron box.

Ashen Adamant.hab: Blackened adamant in magma veins beneath Hell's deepest pits, wreathed in smoke, reached only by long shafts through scalding rock.
Ashen Adamant.how: Sink a deep shaft with heat wards and adamant picks, working for weeks; lava breaks through without warning. Haul it in iron carts.

Infernium.hab: Hell's finest metal, found only in deep veins near Hell's thrones, guarded by archdevils and their legions.
Infernium.how: Mine it under the eye of devil guards, or by a deal with an archdevil, over weeks; every piece comes with a price. Store in a warded chest.

Pit Hellebore.hab: Black hellebore growing at the rims of Hell's deepest pits, clinging to scorched rock above endless drops where screams rise from below.
Pit Hellebore.how: Lean out on a rope and cut the stem with a long blade; one slip means a fall into the pit. Dry the flowers in a sealed jar.

Hallowed Tin.hab: Bright tin washed down cloud-shore streams below Heaven's gates, lying in pebbles on the streambed where the water chimes softly.
Hallowed Tin.how: Pan the streambed with a shallow pan over an afternoon; the tin rings when tapped, so it is easy to find. Store in a cloth bag.

Halo Clover.hab: Four-leafed clover in the meadows below Heaven's gates, growing in patches that glow faintly gold in morning light.
Halo Clover.how: Pick by hand in an hour, only in daylight when the glow shows; keep it pressed in a book.

Sunwheat.hab: Golden wheat in Heaven's open fields, growing tall in warm, constant light on soft rich soil tended by gentle hands; the stalks shine at midday.
Sunwheat.how: Reap with a sickle over a morning and bind into sheaves; ask the field keepers first, as taking without asking spoils the grain. Store in dry sacks.

Cloudstone.hab: Light porous stone on Heaven's cloud plains, forming in drifting slabs on the surface of thick clouds; it floats slightly and bobs in the wind.
Cloudstone.how: Cut slabs with a saw and tie them down with ropes over a few hours; loose pieces drift away. Store under a weighted net.

Dawn Lily.hab: White lilies in Heaven's gardens, growing beside clear pools and paths where morning light falls first; they smell clean and cool.
Dawn Lily.how: Pick with clean hands at dawn, while the petals are open, over an hour; dirty hands wilt them. Keep in fresh water or a sealed jar.

Sunstone.hab: Golden-orange crystals on Heaven's high-altitude desert outcrops, where sunlight is strongest and the rock is warm all day long.
Sunstone.how: Chip crystals off the outcrop with a hammer and chisel at midday over a few hours; carry plenty of water against the heat. Wrap in cloth.

Celestial Marble.hab: Pale marble from the Seven Heavens of the holy mountain, quarried in terraced slopes of shining white stone guarded by celestials.
Celestial Marble.how: Request leave from the guardians, then quarry blocks with wedges and saws over several days; evil hands are burned. Haul in carts on padded straw.

Choir Bronze.hab: Golden bronze cast in the bell-foundries of Heaven's lower choirs, where great bells ring and molten metal pours to the sound of hymns.
Choir Bronze.how: Earn a commission from the foundry choir or trade for spare castings; it sings when struck. Wrap ingots in wool to keep them quiet.

Dawnpetal.hab: Rose-gold flowers on the eastern slopes of Heaven's high meadows, opening at first light each day among dewy grass.
Dawnpetal.how: Gather petals at first light, within the first hour of dawn, using a soft brush; later they close. Dry them on linen in the shade.

Lightwood.hab: Pale glowing trees in Heaven's radiant forests, where light pours through leaves and the bark shines softly in the shade.
Lightwood.how: Fell branches with a silver-edged axe over a day, with permission from the forest wardens; greedy cutting angers them. Season the wood in sunlight.

Manna Crystal.hab: White crystals that form on temple roofs in Heaven, gathering like frost after nights of prayer; they taste faintly sweet.
Manna Crystal.how: Scrape them off temple roofs at dawn with a wooden spatula, with the priests' leave; climbing roofs is risky. Store in clean jars.

Sunfire Citrine.hab: Yellow-orange citrine on Heaven's desert outcrops where sunlight is concentrated, sparkling in cracks of sun-baked rock.
Sunfire Citrine.how: Chip the crystal out with a hammer and chisel in full sun over a few hours; shade dims its glow. Store in a cloth pouch.

Celestial Gold.hab: Gold worked in Heaven's upper planes, given as divine gifts; it glows with inner light and rests in shrines and the hands of the faithful.
Celestial Gold.how: Receive it as a divine gift through faithful service or a holy quest; it cannot be bought. Keep it in a blessed reliquary.

Halo Gold.hab: Gold in Heaven's mines, in bright seams that glow softly in the dark of the tunnels under the holy mountains.
Halo Gold.how: Mine it with a pick over two days, singing hymns as the miners do; greed tarnishes the seam. Store in a padded chest.

Truthstone.hab: White crystals in the courts and temples of justice deities in Heaven, forming in the foundation stones beneath judgment halls.
Truthstone.how: Ask the temple's leave and lift crystals from the foundation with a chisel over a day; liars cannot touch it. Store in white cloth.

Mercy Moss.hab: Soft white moss on the steps of Heaven's halls of mercy, growing where the sick and weary have rested.
Mercy Moss.how: Peel the moss gently with fingers in an hour, only with the healers' blessing; tearing it harms its healing. Store in damp linen.

Positive Energy Crystal.hab: Bright crystals from the Positive Energy Plane, found where Heaven touches it; the light there is blinding and life overflows.
Positive Energy Crystal.how: Approach with eye cover and life-energy wards and take the crystal with gloves in minutes; too much life can burst the body. Store in a lead box.

Sanctified Marble.hab: Pure white marble in Heaven's quarries, in deep layers of blessed stone that shine faintly and feel cool to the touch.
Sanctified Marble.how: Quarry blocks with wedges and saws over several days after a blessing; impure tools crack it. Haul in carts padded with straw.

Skypearl.hab: Pale pearls in Heaven's cloud seas, forming in the hearts of cloud-shells that drift in the high mists.
Skypearl.how: Dive through the clouds with a flight charm and pry open shells with a knife over hours; falling is the danger. Store in soft velvet.

Starfire Opal.hab: Opals with inner fire in volcanic deposits in Heaven where stellar magic gathers, glittering in cooled lava under starry skies.
Starfire Opal.how: Dig them out of volcanic rock with a chisel over a day; collect only at night, when the fire shows. Store in a dark pouch.

Sunsteel Ore.hab: Glowing steel ore in Heaven's sunward cliffs above the high meadows, shining softly hours after sunset in seams that face the sun.
Sunsteel Ore.how: Mine with a pick on the sunward cliff over two days; climbing ropes are needed. Store it in a dark crate to keep its glow.

Truesilver.hab: Silver purified for over a century in Heaven's alchemical sanctuaries, made from ordinary silver rather than found in the ground.
Truesilver.how: Purify silver through a century-long process, or buy or inherit an old batch; impatience spoils it. Store in a blessed box.

Aurorite.hab: Light-shifting metal in Heaven's dawn-lit peaks, in seams that glow with changing colors at sunrise on high, cold slopes.
Aurorite.how: Climb to the peaks and chisel the seam out at dawn over two days; thin air and cold are dangerous. Store wrapped in cloth.

Gracewheat.hab: Golden wheat in fields tended by angels in Heaven, glowing faintly in the dark among perfectly straight rows.
Gracewheat.how: Reap with a sickle over a day only with angelic permission; theft angers the guardians. Store in dry sacks.

Lawful Iron.hab: Perfectly uniform iron from the clockwork plane of law, reached from Heaven's ordered borders, where constructs work it in endless precise lines.
Lawful Iron.how: Trade with or work for the clockwork constructs for weeks; chaos makes them hostile. Store in square crates.

Prophet Crystal.hab: Clear crystals in places in Heaven where fate magic shows itself, growing in shrines of oracles where visions come unbidden.
Prophet Crystal.how: Wait for a vision at the shrine, then take the crystal with gloved hands in minutes; visions overwhelm. Store in a dark box.

Solarite.hab: Golden metal that forms only where Heaven's sunlight has concentrated for centuries, in sun-blazed basins of bright rock.
Solarite.how: Chip it free with tools and eye protection over a day; the glare blinds and the heat scorches. Store in a dark, cool chest.

Starfall Nectar.hab: Sweet glowing nectar in Heaven's star orchards, dripping from blossoms on trees that grow from fallen stars.
Starfall Nectar.how: Collect drops into crystal vials over a night with orchard keepers' leave; greed sours it. Store sealed and cool.

Agestone.hab: Brittle grey-white veins in Heaven's high quarries where the Age Rune's power pools; tree-like rings streak the stone, and it weathers week by week.
Agestone.how: Dig a shaft into the quarry and chisel gently over two days, as it crumbles; age dust weakens joints. Store in padded crates.

Airstone.hab: Nearly weightless pale blue veins in Heaven's windswept peaks where the Air Rune's power pools; loose stones float on the gusts.
Airstone.how: Dig a shaft into the peak and chisel over two days; loose pieces fly off. Store each stone in a weighted, netted box.

Animalstone.hab: Tawny fur-patterned veins in Heaven's wild hunting grounds where the Animal Rune's power pools; beasts gather to lick the salty surface.
Animalstone.how: Dig a shaft over two days, watching for wild beasts drawn to it; they defend the lick. Store in a sealed box.

Artstone.hab: Swirled many-colored veins in Heaven's high rock galleries where the Art Rune's power pools; dawn light paints the stone fresh each day.
Artstone.how: Chisel it with fine artist's tools over two days, preserving the swirls; rough work dulls it. Store in velvet.

Battlestone.hab: Scarred red-brown veins under Heaven's sacred battlefields where the Battle Rune's power pools; the stone is covered in old nicks from great duels.
Battlestone.how: Dig a shaft over two days; spirits of old warriors may test the diggers. Store in iron crates.

Beginning Stone.hab: Clear veins on Heaven's dawn-facing slopes where the Beginning Rune's power pools; each stone holds one bright point of light at its centre.
Beginning Stone.how: Dig at first light over two days; the light dims at night. Store in a clear crystal case.

Belonging Stone.hab: Warm honey-colored veins in Heaven's hearthside caves near old shared homes where the Belonging Rune's power pools.
Belonging Stone.how: Ask the homes' families, then dig over two days; strangers find it cold. Store in a warm wool pouch.

Biggerstone.hab: Swelling veins in Heaven's wide quarries where the Bigger Rune's power pools; boulders grow slowly over decades.
Biggerstone.how: Chisel it over two days; pieces grow if left. Store in a large box with room.

Boost Stone.hab: Bright veins in Heaven's sunlit fields where the Boost Rune's power pools; the stone flares briefly at noon.
Boost Stone.how: Dig a shaft over two days; holding it too long burns. Store in a cool box.

Bowstone.hab: Curved golden-brown veins among the roots of ancient trees in Heaven's hunting forests, where the Bow Rune's power pools.
Bowstone.how: Dig between roots over two days without harming the trees; wardens watch. Store in padded crates.

Changestone.hab: Shimmering veins under Heaven's rivers where the Change Rune's power pools; currents constantly reshape the stones.
Changestone.how: Dam the river and dig a shaft over two days; the stone changes form. Store in a sealed box.

Character Death Stone.hab: Grey veins under Heaven's graveyards where heroes fell and rose again, where the Character Death Rune's power pools; one facet is cracked and faded.
Character Death Stone.how: Dig over two days with respect for the graves; heroes' spirits may test diggers. Store in white linen.

Chastity Stone.hab: Flawless white veins under Heaven's pure untouched springs where the Chastity Rune's power pools; no mark has ever been made on them.
Chastity Stone.how: Dig with clean tools over two days; any mark ruins it. Store wrapped in white silk.

Choir-glass.hab: Ringing glass in Heaven's singing towers, forming in the windows and walls where hymns echo day and night.
Choir-glass.how: Remove panes with the choir's leave over a day, using soft tools; cracks silence it. Store wrapped in wool.

Chronicle Stone.hab: Writing-etched veins in Heaven's archive caves where the Chronicles Rune's power pools; old records were stored in rock.
Chronicle Stone.how: Dig over two days with archivists' leave; damaging records is forbidden. Store flat in padded boxes.

Commercestone.hab: Coin-studded veins under Heaven's great market mountains where trade routes cross, where the Commerce Rune's power pools.
Commercestone.how: Buy a mining claim from the merchants and dig over two days; theft is punished. Store in a strongbox.

Couragestone.hab: Warm gold veins in Heaven's sunlit cliffs where the brave once stood and the Courage Rune's power pools; the glow brightens near fear.
Couragestone.how: Climb and dig over two days; fear makes it brighter and easier to find. Store in a padded pouch.

Creationstone.hab: Milky white veins in Heaven's bright quarries where the Creation Rune's power pools; tiny points of light appear in the stone from nowhere.
Creationstone.how: Chisel it with clean bronze tools over two days in the bright quarry; new specks of light may form as you work. Store in white cloth.

Dawnstone.hab: Rosy orange veins on Heaven's eastern slopes where light first breaks and the Dawn Rune's power pools; the stone brightens as if waking.
Dawnstone.how: Dig at dawn over two days; it dims at night. Store in a clear case.

Daystone.hab: Clear yellow veins under Heaven's open sun-drenched fields where the Day Rune's power pools; the stone holds warm daylight even at midnight.
Daystone.how: Dig over two days; it glows at night. Store in a dark box to save its light.

Deathstone.hab: Cold grey-black veins in Heaven's silent tombs where the Death Rune's power pools; the stone feels like still flesh.
Deathstone.how: Dig in the tombs over two days; death energy chills. Store in a lead box.

Dedicationstone.hab: Plain polished white veins under Heaven's quiet mountain shrines where the Dedication Rune's power pools; the stone looks worn as if held for years.
Dedicationstone.how: Pray at the shrine first, then dig over two days; impatience cracks it. Store in a cloth pouch.

Descendstone.hab: Heavy dark blue veins at Heaven's lowest steps where the Descend Rune's power pools; the stone tugs downward.
Descendstone.how: Dig over two days with a pulley; it pulls toward the ground. Store in a low crate.

Desirestone.hab: Warm rose-pink veins under Heaven's gardens where the Desire Rune's power pools; the stone glows brightest for whoever wants it most.
Desirestone.how: Dig a shaft over two days, taking turns so no one grows covetous and fights over it; desire distracts. Store in a pink silk pouch.

Diplomacystone.hab: Smooth calm blue veins beneath Heaven's meeting halls where the Diplomacy Rune's power pools; angry voices quiet nearby.
Diplomacystone.how: Ask the hall's leave, then dig over two days; arguing is impossible near it. Store in a blue cloth.

Directstone.hab: Long straight white veins in perfectly straight seams of Heaven where the Direct Rune's power pools; hung, the stone always points the same way.
Directstone.how: Dig along the seam over two days, keeping its line; bending snaps it. Store in a long box.

Divergencestone.hab: Forked white veins where Heaven's rivers branch apart and the Divergence Rune's power pools; the stone's veins always split.
Divergencestone.how: Dam the fork and dig over two days; it splits if forced. Store in a padded box.

Divinitystone.hab: Thin, scattered veins under Heaven's holy grounds, thickest beneath old temples where worship has soaked the rock for ages. Seams glow brighter during prayer, betraying their path through pale bedrock.
Divinitystone.how: Dig only with temple leave, using a blessed pick and soft brushes over two or three days. Prayer keeps the glow steady; profane words dull it. Store in white linen inside cedar boxes.

Drystone.hab: Cracked seams running under Heaven's parched plateaus, where the ground is split and dusty and no dew forms. A ring of bone-dry soil marks a vein lying close below.
Drystone.how: Carry extra water; the vein drinks moisture from skin and lips. Chisel slowly with a bronze wedge over a day, then seal pieces in waxed jars so they do not crack further.

Duskstone.hab: Narrow veins in Heaven's western cliffs, visible only at twilight when they glow faintly violet and orange. By full day or deep night the seams look like ordinary rock.
Duskstone.how: Mark the vein at dusk, then work by rope on the cliff face across several evenings. Only stone cut in twilight keeps its glow; wrap it in grey cloth and keep shaded.

Earthstone.hab: Deep beneath Heaven's ancient fields, in heavy brown layers threaded with living roots. Crops above grow unusually tall and the soil feels warm and faintly pulsing underfoot.
Earthstone.how: Sink a lined shaft through the root layers over a week, cutting roots only with a stone knife. Thank the land aloud; rough work makes the vein sink deeper. Store in soil-packed crates.

Faminestone.hab: Under barren fields of Heaven where nothing has grown for centuries. The topsoil is grey and empty, birds avoid the place, and travelers feel sudden hunger near a seam.
Faminestone.how: Eat well before work and bring rations; the vein steals appetite and strength. Pry chunks free with an iron bar over two days and store them in salt-lined lead boxes away from food.

Firestone.hab: Hot veins in Heaven's fiery peaks where spirit flame still dwells in fissures. Rock nearby is scorched gold, and the air shimmers above the ground where a seam runs near the surface.
Firestone.how: Wear soaked leather gloves and heat-warded robes; cut with a tempered steel pick in short shifts over three days. Cool each piece in holy water and store in clay-lined iron chests.

Fixstone.hab: Seams running beneath the edges of Heaven's old repaired temple floors, where silver lines in the paving mark cracks that sealed themselves. Veins follow the line of past mending.
Fixstone.how: Lift floor slabs with priestly consent and chip out the vein over a day. Never shatter it; split pieces mend crookedly and lose power. Wrap each in soft wool and keep whole.

Foresight Stone.hab: Veins in the rock of Heaven's high watchtower ledges, exposed to wind and long views. Clear violet seams flicker with images of things about to happen nearby.
Foresight Stone.how: Climb with ropes and work fast; the stone shows the collector's slip a moment early, which helps. A half day with a fine chisel per piece. Store in velvet so visions stay quiet.

Forgestone.hab: Deep grey veins beneath Heaven's divine smithies, warmed by centuries of holy fire overhead. Cracks in the rock glow orange and the ground rings faintly when stepped on.
Forgestone.how: Mine with a hammer and steel chisel after the forges are banked for the night, over two or three days. Pieces stay hot; carry them in tongs and store on iron racks.

Frost Stone.hab: Veins on still, high slopes of Heaven where water freezes slowly and wind never blows. Feathery rime crystals regrow overnight on exposed rock above a seam.
Frost Stone.how: Work only in the calm hours before dawn with a fur-wrapped pick, two or three days in deep cold. Warmth makes it weep and crack, so pack it in snow inside wooden boxes.

Fruitstone.hab: Under Heaven's ancient orchards, among layers of fallen seeds and old roots. The orchard trees above fruit out of season, and the soil smells of ripe sweetness.
Fruitstone.how: Dig carefully between tree roots with a wooden spade and bare hands for two days; harming a tree spoils the vein. Bees gather to the stone, so smoke them off. Store in straw.

Gambitstone.hab: Beneath ruined strategy halls of Heaven, in checkered seams of black and ivory set in squares like a game board. Old traps and puzzles still guard many of the halls.
Gambitstone.how: Solve or disarm the hall's old trials before digging, then cut blocks square with a fine saw over two days. Breaking a square out of order shatters it. Store in a padded grid case.

Gearstone.hab: Brass-colored veins under Heaven's old foundries, where small natural cogs turn slowly in their rock sockets. A faint ticking in the walls betrays a seam behind the stone.
Gearstone.how: Remove each cog whole with tweezers and a jeweler's pry after cutting the socket open, a slow day of work. Jammed cogs crack. Store in oiled cloth in a compartmented box.

Gloria Myrrh.hab: Grows as resin wept from the trunks of sacred trees in the groves around Heaven's thrones. The groves are guarded, fragrant and bright, and the resin beads thickest at sunrise.
Gloria Myrrh.how: Ask leave of the throne guardians, then cut a shallow notch with a silver knife and catch the drip in a gold dish over a morning. Store hardened tears in sealed glass vials.

Godsteel.hab: Has no natural habitat at all. It appears only where a deity has personally shaped metal by hand, as a gift or reward granted through divine intervention.
Godsteel.how: Cannot be mined, bought or crafted. It must be earned through a deity's favor and received as a gift; attempts to steal it invite divine wrath. Keep it on consecrated ground.

Governancestone.hab: Slate-blue veins beneath the foundations of Heaven's old council halls, crossed by straight gold lines like map borders. Seams follow the outlines of ancient territories above.
Governancestone.how: Gain a council writ, then cut along the gold lines only, using a straightedge and fine chisel over two days. Cutting across a border cracks the stone. Store flat in ledger boxes.

Growstone.hab: Shallow veins under Heaven's sunlit gardens, where tiny crystal sprouts push up through the soil. Garden plants above it bloom larger and earlier than anywhere else.
Growstone.how: Uncover the vein with a hand trowel and lift pieces with roots of crystal intact, a day's gentle work. Give each a pinch of soil and sunlight weekly, or it stops growing.

Habitstone.hab: Under Heaven's heavily trodden pilgrim paths, where countless feet have worn grooves into the rock. Seams warm faintly underfoot along the busiest stretches of road.
Habitstone.how: Dig beside the path at night when pilgrims rest, using the same tool and motions every time over two days. Changing method mid-cut cools the vein. Store in worn leather pouches.

Hammerstone.hab: In Heaven's thunder-struck mountain quarries, deep iron-black seams with flat striking faces. Lightning scars on the quarry walls and a ringing echo mark where it lies.
Hammerstone.how: Split it out with heavy sledges and steel wedges over three days, hearing protection on. It rings loud enough to deafen. Store pieces on padded shelves so they do not chime.

Healstone.hab: Beneath temple altars and holy springs of Heaven, in soft white seams that glow warmer near the sick. Pilgrims healed above it often leave offerings that mark the spot.
Healstone.how: With priestly permission, lift the altar stones and scrape the soft vein out with a silver spoon over a day. Rough cutting dims it. Store wrapped in clean bandage cloth.

Healthstone.hab: Deep beneath Heaven's curing springs, in red-pink seams that pulse in time with nearby heartbeats. The spring water above tastes of iron and warms the drinker.
Healthstone.how: Dig a lined shaft beside the spring over four days, keeping it dry with pumps. Only a calm, healthy miner can hold the vein steady. Store in damp moss in sealed jars.

Hearingstone.hab: Spiraled veins in Heaven's cliffs where the wind echoes endlessly. Pale blue shell-like seams hum when the wind blows across them, guiding a listener to the exact spot.
Hearingstone.how: Follow the humming by ear, then cut the spiral out whole with a curved chisel over a day. Loud noise near it can deafen the collector. Store in wool-stuffed boxes.

Heatstone.hab: Near Heaven's sunbaked rocks and quiet hot springs, in red-orange seams that never cool. Air shimmers above the vein even at night, and snow never settles on it.
Heatstone.how: Wear thick gloves and dig with a long-handled pick over two days, resting often. Water on the vein bursts into scalding steam. Carry it in fire-clay pots on a padded frame.

Herbstone.hab: Under Heaven's wild meadows and alchemists' hillside gardens, in leafy-patterned green seams. The ground smells of crushed herbs and sharp sap where a vein lies close.
Herbstone.how: Dig between herb patches with a wooden trowel over a day, sparing the plants. Crushed herbs above it lose their potency for a year. Store in paper packets with dried sage.

Hornstone.hab: In Heaven's high grazing slopes where horned beasts once shed their crowns. Curved bone-white and brown veins lie in old antler beds buried under layers of turf.
Hornstone.how: Cut away turf, then lever the curved pieces free with a horn-tipped pry over two days. The sharp tips gore careless hands. Store points down in padded racks.

Infinitestone.hab: At the very edges of Heaven's sky, where land thins into endless blue. Deep blue nodes cling to floating crags and cliff lips that face out over nothing.
Infinitestone.how: Reach the sky's edge with flight or long rope work, then pry nodes free over a day. Staring into them too long traps the gaze and mind. Store in lidded opaque boxes.

Inheritancestone.hab: Within the walls and floors of Heaven's old royal tombs, in dark amber seams layered like tree rings. Each layer bears faint marks of the dead who lay nearby.
Inheritancestone.how: Gain consent from the royal line, then cut with a fine saw over two days. Robbing a tomb curses the stone to its thief. Store in sealed ancestral chests with a family token.

Joystone.hab: Under quiet fields of Heaven where pure light pools, in sunny-yellow veins threaded with white. Wildflowers bloom thickest above it and visitors smile without knowing why.
Joystone.how: Dig with a light spade in good spirits over a day; anger or grief dulls the vein. Laughter makes the stone easier to lift free. Store in yellow silk in a sunny room.

Jumpstone.hab: On Heaven's mountaintops and windy cliffs, in springy pale green veins that twitch in the rock. Loose pebbles nearby hop on their own, revealing a seam close below.
Jumpstone.how: Cut pieces free with a net held ready over two days; loose chunks leap away off cliffs. Hold them in a closed fist. Store in weighted leather bags tied shut.

Justicestone.hab: Beneath the steps of Heaven's ancient courts, in perfectly level veins half silver and half gold. The steps above never tilt, no matter how old or worn they are.
Justicestone.how: Requires a court's leave and an honest miner; a liar's chisel slips. Cut evenly from both sides over two days so the balance holds. Store flat on a level shelf.

Katanastone.hab: In Heaven's hard steel veins, thin curved seams with a wave pattern like a tempered blade. Such veins run along old battle ridges, sharp enough to cut careless climbers.
Katanastone.how: Wear heavy gloves and cut along the curve with a diamond saw over three days. Snapping the edge ruins it. Store sheathed in wooden scabbards lined with oiled cloth.

Knowledgestone.hab: Beneath Heaven's ancient libraries and sages' tombs, in dense blue-violet seams written with tiny shifting script. The lower stacks smell of old ink where a vein runs near.
Knowledgestone.how: Work quietly with a fine chisel over several days; reading the script while cutting distracts and causes slips. Store in book-sized cases away from bright lamps.

Landstone.hab: Across Heaven's peaceful plains and level ground, in calm brown seams that never shift. Earthquakes do not touch the land above, and still ponds form in its hollows.
Landstone.how: Dig steadily with ordinary picks and spades over two days; haste makes the vein sink. It is heavy, so bring a cart. Store on stable ground floors, never on high shelves.

Laststone.hab: In the final, deepest seam of Heaven's mines, past every other vein. Its dusky gold grain fades toward one dim edge, and the tunnel there is quiet and warm.
Laststone.how: Reach the end of the deepest mine over many days, then take only one piece per visit with a fine pick. Greedy miners find the seam closed. Store in dark gold cloth.

Lifestone.hab: In Heaven's fertile hillsides, in warm green seams flecked with gold. Sprouts push up wherever loose chunks lie, so a cluster of sudden seedlings marks a vein below.
Lifestone.how: Dig gently with a wooden spade over two days and replant any disturbed roots. Raw pieces sprout plants, so store them in dry stone boxes away from soil.

Lightningstone.hab: In Heaven's storm-struck peaks, jagged pale-yellow veins where bolts strike most often. Sparks crawl over the rock and hair stands on end when standing above a seam.
Lightningstone.how: Work between storms only, wearing rubber-soled boots and using a wooden-handled pick, over two days. Metal tools draw shocks. Store in glass jars lined with dry sand.

Lightstone.hab: In Heaven's sunlit peaks, clear veins glowing with soft white radiance. The glow brightens when people nearby laugh or cheer, so seams shine near festival camps.
Lightstone.how: Cut with a polished steel chisel over a day while singing or joking to keep the glow strong. Darkness dims it for weeks. Store in clear glass cases in bright rooms.

Lovestone.hab: Beneath Heaven's gardens where couples walk, in rose-pink veins with a warm inner glow. Seams shine brighter where devoted pairs have sat together for years.
Lovestone.how: Best dug by two people who care for each other, working together with soft tools over a day. Lonely or bitter miners find it dull. Store in pairs in red velvet.

Loyaltystone.hab: In the foundations of Heaven's keeps, in deep blue veins with a steady shine. The walls above never fall to siege, and guards report a sense of calm resolve there.
Loyaltystone.how: Cut with a fine chisel over two days by one miner only; the first person to hold it becomes its bearer. It grows cold away from them. Store in the bearer's keeping.

Martialstone.hab: Under Heaven's training grounds, in dense sand-colored seams worn into grip shapes. Packed earth above holds the footprints of drills, and the ground rings under strikes.
Martialstone.how: It hardens when struck, so cut it with slow sawing rather than hammering over three days. Bring trained fighters; spirits of old warriors test intruders. Store on weapon racks.

Mendstone.hab: In Heaven's healing springs, soft white seams streaked pale green in the rock beneath the water. Cracks in the spring basin above it seal themselves overnight.
Mendstone.how: Drain or dive the spring, then scrape the soft vein with a silver blade over a day. Cracked pieces heal overnight if kept together. Store wet in sealed clay jars.

Mercystone.hab: Beneath the floors of Heaven's chapels, in milk-white seams cool to the touch. The air above is calm and still, and the stone dims where blood has been spilled.
Mercystone.how: Dig with blessed tools in a peaceful mood over a day; never draw blood nearby or the vein dims for a season. Store in white linen in a quiet chapel room.

Migrationstone.hab: Along Heaven's great trails, in banded brown and white seams whose stripes always point toward a distant warm place. Flocks pass overhead along the same lines.
Migrationstone.how: Follow the stripes to where the vein surfaces near a trail, then chisel along the bands over two days. Cutting across them scrambles their pointing. Store in a marked case.

Moldstone.hab: In clay-brown banks along Heaven's slow rivers, soft seams that keep any shape pressed into them. Old handprints and footprints in the bank betray a vein close below.
Moldstone.how: Dig with wooden paddles over a day and handle gently; every press leaves a mark. Lift chunks with cloth slings. Store in shaped wooden molds so they keep their form.

Musicstone.hab: In the rock of Heaven's high echoing halls, slender veins that hum different notes when struck. Faint chords sound in the halls whenever the wind passes through.
Musicstone.how: Tap the walls to find the singing vein, then saw slender pieces free over two days. A wrong blow cracks it and leaves it tone-deaf. Store in felt-lined cases like instruments.

Numbstone.hab: In cold, quiet ravines of Heaven, in pale blue veins that chill the surrounding rock. Climbers feel their fingers tingle and go numb when they grip the walls above.
Numbstone.how: Wear thick fur gloves and swap workers often; bare skin goes dead within minutes. Cut with long-handled tools over two days. Store in wool-wrapped boxes, handling briefly.

Nurturestone.hab: Under Heaven's gardens, warm brown seams that draw flowers and young animals. Plants grow fuller above it and nesting creatures gather wherever a vein runs shallow.
Nurturestone.how: Move any nests aside gently before digging with a wooden trowel over a day. Harming young creatures sours the vein. Store in a warm, padded basket.

Obsidian Stone.hab: In Heaven's volcanic scars, glossy black veins with razor edges along old cooled flows. Surfaces reflect light like dark water, easy to spot under the bright sky.
Obsidian Stone.how: Wear heavy gloves and eye guards; flakes cut deep. Knap pieces free with a horn hammer over a day. Store wrapped in thick leather, edges padded with cork.

Orderstone.hab: In the walls and floors of Heaven's ordered halls, perfectly cubic white seams with straight edges. The halls above are always tidy and every tile lies square.
Orderstone.how: Cut along natural edges only with a square and fine saw over two days. Messy or rushed work cracks the cubes. Store stacked neatly in square-cut wooden boxes.

Originstone.hab: In Heaven's oldest bedrock, far below newer layers, in swirling seams of every color. Each band seems to point back toward a single deep source in the rock.
Originstone.how: Requires a deep shaft and a week of careful work with fine picks. Cutting against the swirl ruins its layers. Store in layered cloth inside an old stone chest.

Petstone.hab: In shallow veins under Heaven's meadows, small warm stones that animals love to nuzzle. Rabbits and small creatures den above it and sleep curled over the ground.
Petstone.how: Coax animals away with food, then dig with hands and a small trowel over a morning. Frightening creatures cools the stone. Store in a soft, warm pouch.

Physicstone.hab: Under old healers' huts and herb plots of Heaven, in worn brown seams crusted with dried herbs. These sites predate the church and are often forgotten or overgrown.
Physicstone.how: Dig gently with a bone trowel over a day, keeping the herb crust intact; washing it strips its power. Store in dry paper inside a healer's satchel.

Plaguestone.hab: In a few quarantined hollows of Heaven, sickly green-black veins spotted with spreading rot. Ground above is blighted and visitors grow feverish within an hour.
Plaguestone.how: Wear sealed masks, gloves and holy charms; work in short shifts over two days and burn your clothes after. Store in lead boxes sealed with wax, far from people.

Planestone.hab: In layered seams of Heaven where the realm brushes other planes, each band a different shade. Strange lights and foreign smells drift up from the rock nearby.
Planestone.how: Split along the layers with a thin blade over two days. Breaking across them can open a brief rift. Store flat between felt sheets in a warded case.

Planetstone.hab: In hollow geodes deep in Heaven's rock, where clusters of round stones orbit each other without touching. Faint humming and slight weight changes mark a cavity nearby.
Planetstone.how: Open the geode slowly with a fine saw over two days and lift the cluster as one in a cupped net. Separating the stones stops them. Store in a round padded case.

Poisonstone.hab: In damp, shaded clefts of Heaven where plants wilt and wither, dark green veins sweat a bitter liquid. The rock is slick and a sour smell hangs in the air.
