Poisonstone.how: Wear sealed gloves and masks; the sweat burns skin. Chisel out over two days and rinse tools after. Store in glazed jars with tight lids, away from food and plants.

Preservestone.hab: In Heaven's oldest dry vaults and caves, pale seams that never weather. Things left near them stay fresh for years, so ancient untouched offerings mark the vein.
Preservestone.how: Cut slowly with a fine chisel over two days; it is hard and never wears. Lay food or herbs beside it to test it. Store in a cool, dry chest.

Protection Stone.hab: Beneath Heaven's temple foundations under every older ward, broad milky white veins with a soft dome of glow. Wards above it never fail, and intruders feel pushed back.
Protection Stone.how: Requires temple consent and lifting ancient warded stones, a careful week's work. Breaking a ward too fast lashes out at the miner. Store in a warded white chest.

Protectstone.hab: In Heaven's fortress hills, gray seams that harden into overlapping scales as they cool. Fortress walls above stand unbreached, and the hills ring dully when struck.
Protectstone.how: Cut between the scales with a narrow chisel over three days; striking the plates only hardens them. Store layered in padded crates to keep the scales intact.

Punishstone.hab: Beneath the seats of Heaven's courts of judgment where oaths are sworn, heavy bronze veins etched with chain-like lines. Oathbreakers feel weight and dread near them.
Punishstone.how: Only an honest miner can work it; chains tighten on liars' hands. Cut slowly with bronze tools over two days by court leave. Store in iron-banded boxes.

Puritystone.hab: In clear springs of Heaven where nothing else grows, flawless white seams that repel dirt and blood. The water above is perfectly clean and the basin bare.
Puritystone.how: Bathe and fast a day before collecting, then cut underwater with a silver chisel. Unclean hands make it slip away. Store in clean white silk inside glass.

Ragestone.hab: Under Heaven's old war grounds, blood-red veins cracked with hot black lines. The ground there is scarred and the glow surges whenever a fight breaks out nearby.
Ragestone.how: Keep calm; anger makes the vein flare and burn. Cut with heat-proof gloves over two days, breaking up any quarrels. Store in cold iron boxes away from crowds.

Rainstone.hab: In the beds of Heaven's cloud-fed lakes, translucent blue-grey seams always beaded with water. Mist rises off the lake where a vein lies close below.
Rainstone.how: Dive or drain the shallows, then chisel pieces free over two days. Keep flames away; it steams and cracks. Store damp in glass jars with loose lids.

Recaststone.hab: In the walls of Heaven's study towers, silver seams etched with faint circles that refill like ink. Spent magic drifts down as dust where a vein runs below.
Recaststone.how: Collect between lessons with fine picks over a day; spellcasting nearby blurs the circles. Store in dark cases so the circles can refill.

Redundancy Stone.hab: In the foundations of Heaven's foundries, paired seams fused along a central join. Each vein runs beside an identical twin, much like the hidden spares built into the halls.
Redundancy Stone.how: Always cut both halves together along the seam over two days; taking one alone cracks the other. Store the pairs bound together in double cases.

Revelstone.hab: Under Heaven's festival grounds, colorful glittering seams that dance in the light. Music and laughter seem louder above them, and the turf is worn by dancers.
Revelstone.how: Dig during festivals when the vein is most lively, using light picks over a day. Gloomy work makes it dull. Store in bright cloth in a box with a little music box.

Seasonstone.hab: In Heaven's high meadows where four winds meet, seams whose color drifts through green, gold, brown and white over a year. Weather above changes quickly with the wind.
Seasonstone.how: Dig in the season whose power is wanted, with simple tools over two days. The stone keeps the color of the season it was cut. Store in a box marked with the season.

Seduction Stone.hab: Beneath Heaven's garden pavilions near lovers' fountains, rose-pink veins that seem to lean toward watchers. The air there is warm, sweet and heavy with perfume.
Seduction Stone.how: Collectors should be strong-willed; the stone draws them to linger and forget work. Cut with a fine chisel over a day with a partner to call breaks. Store in covered velvet.

Separation Stone.hab: In Heaven's sky canyons where land and air were first pulled apart, seams split cleanly through yet never falling apart. The canyon walls stand far apart with sheer drops.
Separation Stone.how: Rope down the canyon wall and cut around the whole split piece over two days. Prying the halves apart ruins it. Store in a hinged box that keeps halves together.

Shadowstone.hab: In Heaven's grave hills where corpse shadows linger, smoky black veins more shape than solid. The hills are dim even at noon, and shadows move strangely near the seam.
Shadowstone.how: Work under lamps from many angles over two days; stone without a shadow slips through the fingers. Grave spirits may object. Store in black velvet in a dark chest.

Shamanstone.hab: In Heaven's spirit groves among old whispering trees, green seams crossed with feather patterns that rustle faintly. Ancestral voices grow louder near the vein.
Shamanstone.how: Offer tobacco or song to the grove's spirits, then dig at the roots with a bone tool over two days. Disrespect drives the vein away. Store in a feathered medicine bag.

Signalstone.hab: On Heaven's beacon peaks and messenger towers, bright orange seams that pulse with flashes of light in pairs. Night travelers see the blinking from far away.
Signalstone.how: Climb at night when the flashes reveal it, then chisel pieces free over a day. Covering one piece makes its pair blink wildly. Store in covered lanterns.

Skystone.hab: On Heaven's highest peaks above the weather line, pale blue seams with drifting clouds inside. The air is thin and cold and only wind reaches the summits.
Skystone.how: Climb for several days with ropes and air charms, then cut with a light pick in short spells. Thin air makes miners faint. Store in clear glass cases.

Smithstone.hab: In Heaven's forge-mountains, soot-dark seams shot with glowing orange flecks. The mountains smoke from old vents and ring like anvils under hammer blows.
Smithstone.how: Work with a smith's hammer and tongs over three days in heat-warded clothing. It rings loud enough to deafen. Store on iron racks and quench new pieces in oil.

Snowstone.hab: In Heaven's high valleys where snow falls without wind, soft white seams that crumble into flakes and reform in silence. The valley floors are hushed and deep with snow.
Snowstone.how: Dig in still weather with a wooden scoop over a day; noise or warmth makes it crumble. Store packed in snow inside insulated boxes kept cold.

Sovereign Stone.hab: Beneath Heaven's throne halls, deep purple veins crowned with gold. Everyone nearby feels the urge to bow, and the halls are guarded by loyal sentinels.
Sovereign Stone.how: Requires a ruler's permission and great willpower; most miners kneel and cannot work. Cut with gold tools over three days. Store in a crowned, locked case.

Spearstone.hab: Under Heaven's training grounds and along paths of ancient phalanxes, long thin grey seams ending in sharp points. They run in straight lines like spears in formation.
Spearstone.how: Cut lengthwise with a long saw over two days, wearing thick gloves. Snapping the point ruins it. Store upright in a spear rack with padded tips.

Speechstone.hab: Under Heaven's lecture halls and poets' amphitheaters, smooth golden seams that hum with faint voices. The halls echo with whispered speech even when empty.
Speechstone.how: Dig in silence with a fine chisel over a day; shouting near it cracks the vein. Store in cloth-lined boxes where its voices are muffled.

Speedstone.hab: Under Heaven's racetracks and mountain paths worn smooth by runners, sleek silver seams streaked as if moving. Gravel above seems to drift in the direction of the race.
Speedstone.how: Work quickly with a sharp pick over a day; slow work lets the vein slip away. Hold pieces firmly. Store in weighted boxes so they do not roll off.

Spinstone.hab: In Heaven's windswept towers and in the eyes of small whirlwinds, round spiral-banded stones that turn slowly on their own. Dust devils circle above where they lie.
Spinstone.how: Wait for the whirlwind to settle, then pick stones out with tongs over a morning. Grabbing a spinning one wrenches the wrist. Store in round sockets.

Strengthstone.hab: In the training grounds of Heaven's heroic gods, heavy rust-red seams with thick ridged grain. The earth there is packed hard from countless feats of strength.
Strengthstone.how: Requires sledges and strong backs over three days; the ore is very heavy. Weaklings cannot lift it. Store on reinforced shelves on the ground floor.

Studystone.hab: In Heaven's quiet ridges, pale blue seams layered in thin translucent sheets like pages. Scholars' hermitages often sit above, and the ridges are calm and still.
Studystone.how: Peel the sheets apart with a thin blade over two days, never tearing them. Each layer brightens with use. Store flat in book cases between paper.

Subtract Stone.hab: In hollow, half-empty chambers deep in the vaults of Heaven, smooth black seams that seem smaller each time you glance away. Things left nearby go missing.
Subtract Stone.how: Never look away while cutting; it shrinks when unwatched. Work in pairs over two days with fine chisels. Store in clear glass so it can always be seen.

Success Stone.hab: Atop Heaven's victory altars and finish lines, bright golden seams with a laurel-like grain. The ground there is worn by triumphant feet and littered with old wreaths.
Success Stone.how: Only those who have won a true contest can cut it; others find it slips. Work with gold tools over a day. Store wrapped in a laurel wreath in a trophy case.

Swampstone.hab: In the drowned groves of Heaven's marshlands, soft mottled green-brown seams slick with moss. The water is black and rot smells thick above the vein.
Swampstone.how: Dredge it up with long rakes and nets over two days, wading waist deep. Leeches and marsh spirits trouble the collector. Store in wet sacks inside barrels.

Symbiosis Stone.hab: In Heaven's gardens where vines and trees knot together, green seams grown through with living roots and moss. The plants above flourish as if sharing strength.
Symbiosis Stone.how: Cut out the stone with its roots and moss intact using a pruning knife over a day. Tearing the roots kills both. Store in a damp, planted box.

Theftstone.hab: In hidden robbers' caches across Heaven, black seams with a sly silver glint that never stay where they were left. Secret tunnels and false walls hide the veins.
Theftstone.how: Find a cache, then cut fast with a silent chisel over a night. Turn your back and it moves. Store in a locked box with the key on a chain around your neck.

Thoughtstone.hab: In Heaven's high plateaus, violet seams with a cloudy swirl. Thoughts drift slower and clearer near them, and meditating hermits often camp above the veins.
Thoughtstone.how: Work slowly with a fine chisel over two days in a calm mind; scattered thoughts crack the swirl. Store in violet cloth in a quiet room.

Tidestone.hab: On Heaven's tidal flats, sea-blue seams with silver crescent markings exposed at low tide. Their weight rises and falls with the moon, and they shift the sands around them.
Tidestone.how: Dig only at low tide with spades and sledges, watching the water return. Cutting at the wrong moon makes pieces impossibly heavy. Store in salt water jars.

Traditionstone.hab: Buried beneath old hearths and shrines in Heaven, worn grey seams carved with faded family marks. Each lies under a home tended by the same family for generations.
Traditionstone.how: Ask the family's blessing, then lift the hearthstone and dig over a day with old tools passed down. Taking without leave dims it. Store at a family shrine.

Transmission Stone.hab: At the edges of rainbows and around signal towers in Heaven, rainbow-banded crystals that flicker when another nearby is touched. They appear where rainbows touch the ground.
Transmission Stone.how: Chase the rainbow's end after rain and gather crystals in a few minutes before it fades. Touch only with gloves to stop false signals. Store apart in padded boxes.

Treasurestone.hab: Piled in hoards and dragon-sized vaults across Heaven, glittering seams studded with gold flecks and gem shards. Vault guardians and old traps often protect them.
Treasurestone.how: Get past or bargain with the vault guardians, then chip the vein free over two days. Greed sets off traps. Store in a locked strongbox with a ledger.

Trialstone.hab: In Heaven's arenas and judgment halls, dark grey seams marked with two crossed grooves. Champions are tested above, and the ground bears the scars of duels.
Trialstone.how: Win a trial in the arena to earn the right to cut it, then work with blade-edged chisels over a day. Unproven hands get cut. Store in a crossed-blade case.

Tweakstone.hab: In Heaven's mines, shifting violet veins whose facets rearrange when no one looks. Tunnel walls around them seem slightly different each time a miner returns.
Tweakstone.how: Mark the seam with chalk and keep watching while cutting over two days. Pieces change shape when unseen. Store in a clear case and check them daily.

Unlockstone.hab: Near opened vaults and broken gates in Heaven, brass-colored seams with small keyhole hollows. Doors near them tend to swing open on their own.
Unlockstone.how: Cut with a lockpick-fine chisel over a day; forcing the hollows shut cracks it. Keep it away from your own locks. Store in an open tray, not a locked box.

Visionstone.hab: On Heaven's high watchtowers and lookout peaks, bright eye-shaped seams with dark pupil-like centers. The view from above them stretches farther than it should.
Visionstone.how: Climb to the lookout and chisel the eye out whole over a day. Damaging the pupil blinds the stone. Store in a covered case so it does not stare.

Voyagestone.hab: Along Heaven's long roads and sea routes, weathered compass-veined seams that always tip toward home. They lie under milestones and old harbor walls.
Voyagestone.how: Dig beneath milestones or harbor walls over a day with simple picks. The stone points to its finder's home ever after. Store in a travel pouch with a compass.

Waterstone.hab: In springs, wells and river sources of Heaven, clear blue seams cool and slightly wet. Fresh water bubbles up wherever a vein reaches the surface.
Waterstone.how: Dig beside the spring with a bronze spade over a day, keeping the flow clear. Drying it out cracks it. Store in water-filled glass jars.

Wavestone.hab: Along Heaven's shores and reefs, sea-green seams with rippled bands that ebb and flow in color. Waves break oddly over them, showing where they lie.
Wavestone.how: Dive at calm water with a chisel and weighted line over two days. Rough seas make it slip. Store in seawater tanks or damp seaweed.

Wealthstone.hab: Under Heaven's treasuries and merchant halls, heavy gleaming gold-veined seams. Coins seem to gather near them, and the halls above are always busy with trade.
Wealthstone.how: Buy mining rights from the merchants, then cut with sturdy picks over two days. It is very heavy and attracts thieves. Store in a guarded vault.

Weavestone.hab: Under Heaven's sacred looms and spell halls, fine thread-veined seams woven through with colorful strands. Magic and cloth hang in the air above.
Weavestone.how: Unpick it strand by strand with a weaver's needle and chisel over two days. Cutting the threads unravels it. Store rolled in silk like a tapestry.

Wetstone.hab: In Heaven's damp meadows and dew-covered fields, dark blue seams always beaded with moisture. The grass above stays wet even in noon sunlight.
Wetstone.how: Dig with a spade at dawn over a day while the dew is thick. It dries and cracks in hot sun. Store in damp moss in sealed jars.

Wisdomstone.hab: Under Heaven's temples and quiet libraries, deep blue seams with owl-eye flecks. Minds clear in the halls above and owls nest in the rafters.
Wisdomstone.how: Work in silence and patience over two days with a fine chisel. Haste or pride makes it dull. Store in a quiet library case.

Wordstone.hab: Beneath Heaven's scriptoriums and poets' graves, smooth grey seams with faint letters drifting under the surface. Ink stains and old verses mark the ground above.
Wordstone.how: Cut with a quill-fine chisel over a day, reading aloud a verse to calm the letters. Careless words scramble it. Store between pages of a blank book.

Yangstone.hab: In sunlit Heaven fields, bright white seams with a small dark dot, warm and lively in the hand. They always lie near a matching dark seam in shade.
Yangstone.how: Dig at midday in full sun over a day; shade weakens it. Best taken with its Yin partner. Store in a warm, bright place beside its pair.

Yinstone.hab: In shadowed Heaven groves, dark black seams with a small white dot, cool and still. They always lie near a matching bright seam in nearby sunlight.
Yinstone.how: Dig at night or in deep shade over a day; sunlight weakens it. Best taken with its Yang partner. Store in a cool, dark place beside its pair.

Youthstone.hab: Among Heaven's orchards and springs, fresh green seams that seem newer each day. Plants above stay young and blossoming and animals there never seem to age.
Youthstone.how: Dig gently with a wooden trowel over a day. Old or weary miners may feel briefly younger. Store in damp cloth in a cool spring house.

Celestial Starfire.hab: Forms only at sites of divine manifestation in Heaven's upper planes, where a god once touched the world. Gems shine with their own light and the ground is scorched holy white.
Celestial Starfire.how: Must be found, never made; reach the site by pilgrimage and pray for days before lifting it with bare clean hands. Theft brings divine anger. Store in gold reliquaries.

Ichor Bronze.hab: Does not form naturally. It is made in Heaven's alchemy halls by alloying bronze with distilled ichor from aberrant creatures, leaving yellow-green corrosive metal.
Ichor Bronze.how: Hunt aberrations for ichor, then distill and alloy it in warded crucibles over a week. Wear acid-proof gloves and eye guards. Store in glass-lined boxes.

Sunwell Lotus.hab: Floats on the sunwell pool where Heaven's light is drawn, a blazing white lotus in water too bright to look at. Only a few bloom, guarded by angelic keepers.
Sunwell Lotus.how: Win the keepers' leave, then wade in wearing dark visors and cut the stem with a gold knife. Bruised petals lose their light. Store in sun-filled glass vases.

Sun Orichalcum.hab: In molten seams deep in the sunwell crater of Heaven, orichalcum flecked with living light. The crater is scorching and blinding, and angels guard its rim.
Sun Orichalcum.how: Requires angelic permission, warded armor and dark visors; ladle the metal from molten seams with long tools over days. Only angelic smiths can work it. Store in warded crucibles.

Churnstone.hab: Common through the Churn of the Chaos Realm, in low ridges and broken ground. The stone slowly reshapes itself, so outcrops look different from day to day.
Churnstone.how: Cut blocks with an ordinary pick in a few hours and bind them with iron straps before they shift. Store tied tight in a crate.

Maybe-Moss.hab: Grows everywhere in the Chaos Realm, on rocks, trees and walls. Each patch looks a little different, and its effect changes with every harvest.
Maybe-Moss.how: Scrape it into a pouch with a knife in minutes. Test a pinch before use, since each harvest acts differently. Store patches apart in labeled bags.

Petrified Lightning.hab: At lightning strike sites on Chaos sand plains, where bolts fuse the sand into glass tubes. Fresh strike scars and blackened rings mark where to dig.
Petrified Lightning.how: Dig carefully around the glass tubes with a trowel and brush over an hour. They snap easily. Store wrapped in cloth in sand-filled boxes.

Shiftgrass.hab: Covers the open plains of the Chaos Realm, grass that changes color and length each time you look away. Wide fields of it ripple in every shade.
Shiftgrass.how: Cut a bundle with a sickle in minutes while keeping your eyes on it. Store in dark sacks so its changes slow down.

Earthquake Amber.hab: Buried in old sediment of quake-prone regions of the Chaos Realm, ancient amber lumps. The ground trembles often, and cracks in the soil reveal yellow glints.
Earthquake Amber.how: Dig in shallow pits with a spade over a day, watching for tremors. Items with it vibrate, so wrap pieces in wool and store in padded boxes.

Flux Iron.hab: In shallow seams throughout the Churn, iron that slowly changes alloy. Rust colors on the rock shift between red, grey and blue from week to week.
Flux Iron.how: Mine with a pick in a day and smelt fast before it changes. Store in tied bundles and record the alloy at the time of cutting.

Quick Iron.hab: On shifting scree slopes of the Chaos Realm, restless iron that creeps across the ground when unwatched. Trails in the scree show where it has moved.
Quick Iron.how: Watch it constantly and grab chunks with iron tongs over a few hours. Bent pieces snap back. Store in locked iron boxes or it crawls away.

Mad Morel.hab: In fungal tangles deep in chaos caverns, twisted morels whose spores whisper nonsense. Damp, dark tunnels fill with the faint murmuring of thousands of caps.
Mad Morel.how: Wear a cloth mask and earplugs; spores muddle the mind. Cut at the base with a small knife over an hour. Store in sealed jars.

Twistroot.hab: In the Churn, roots that twist and knot through the shifting ground. Flexible and living, they coil around stones and move slowly toward water.
Twistroot.how: Dig out long lengths with a spade and cut with a saw over a day. Keep them damp so they stay flexible. Store in wet sacks.

Voidsap Wood.hab: Grows near void rifts in the Chaos Realm, trees whose grain is slightly see-through and cold. Frost forms on the bark, and the air around them feels thin.
Voidsap Wood.how: Fell with a steel axe over a day, staying back from the rift. Wear warm gloves; the wood chills skin. Store in warm, dry sheds.

Wild Magic Prismastone.hab: At magical disaster sites of the Chaos Realm, where wild magic burst loose. Gems shift color, shape and size and hurt to look at, scattered among strange craters.
Wild Magic Prismastone.how: Wear dark glasses and grab it fast with padded tongs in under an hour. Stray spells erupt near it. Store in a lead box with no windows.

Shifting Ore.hab: Deep in the Churn, chaos metal that changes shape in its seams. Tunnels around it are uneven and walls bulge and sink as the ore moves.
Shifting Ore.how: Mine with a strong pick over two days, bracing the tunnel. Pieces shift shape, so clamp them in iron vices. Store in shaped molds.

Stormthistle.hab: On the Chaos Realm's storm peaks, spiky thistles crackling with static that draw lightning. Lightning strikes the slopes often where they grow.
Stormthistle.how: Pick between storms with rubber gloves and a wooden-handled sickle over an hour. Never carry metal. Store in glass jars away from metal.

Thunder Iron.hab: In the storm peaks of the Chaos Realm where lightning never stops, iron charged by endless strikes. The rock crackles and smells of burnt air.
Thunder Iron.how: Mine with wooden-handled tools and insulated boots over three days, sheltering from bolts. It shocks when struck. Store in clay jars lined with sand.

Void Iron.hab: Forms in pockets of compressed void between planes at the Chaos Realm's edges. Dark purple-sheened lumps float in silent, empty gaps between worlds.
Void Iron.how: Reach the void pocket by planar travel and pull lumps free with force-warded gloves over a day. Ordinary wards cannot hold it. Store in solid iron vaults.

Wild Quartz.hab: Along rift edges in the Chaos Realm, quartz charged with wild magic. Crystals jut from torn ground and flicker in strange colors near the rift.
Wild Quartz.how: Chip crystals free with a hammer and chisel over a few hours, staying clear of the rift. Stray spells may fire. Store in warded boxes.

Chaos Matter.hab: Drifts in the endless churn of Limbo in the Chaos Realm, raw matter with no fixed form. It only takes shape when someone forces it to with sheer will.
Chaos Matter.how: Requires a strong-willed collector to focus for hours and hold it in one shape. A lapse in focus unmakes it. Store in a warded box and visit it often.

Entropy Gourd.hab: Grows on wild vines of the Chaos Realm, lopsided gourds whose flesh changes with every slice. The vines sprawl over rocks and ruins and move slowly.
Entropy Gourd.how: Cut the stem with a sharp knife in minutes and carry the gourd whole. Slicing it early spoils it. Store in a cool cellar.

Kaleidoscope Ore.hab: In the prismatic canyons of unstable stone in the Chaos Realm, ore whose color, weight and hardness change every hour. The canyon walls flash with color.
Kaleidoscope Ore.how: Mine with an adjustable pick over two days, timing cuts to softer hours. Rockfalls are common. Store in padded crates and note its state hourly.

Probability Crystal.hab: On stormglass flats of the Chaos Realm, crystals that bend luck. They lie half buried in glassy sand under constant storms.
Probability Crystal.how: Pick crystals from the sand by hand over a few hours, between storms. Luck around you flickers. Store in padded pouches.

Void Nullstone.hab: In the spaces between planes, where even void has thinned into nothing. These places of absolute magical silence lie far beyond any road, and no light reaches them.
Void Nullstone.how: Reach the null space by planar travel with no magic to protect you, then lift the stone with bare hands. It cancels spells and cannot be warded. Store in plain lead.

Kaleid Fern.hab: In the prismatic canyons of the Chaos Realm, fern fronds of shifting color that flicker in and out of sight. They grow in shady corners near falling water.
Kaleid Fern.how: Cut fronds with silver scissors over an hour, waiting for them to be visible. Bruised fronds fade away. Store in dark glass jars.

Living Metal.hab: In breathing veins in the walls of chaos caverns, warm metal that pulses and heals its own scratches. The cavern walls swell and shrink like slow breath.
Living Metal.how: Cut quickly with a sharp chisel over two days before the vein heals. Keep flame away, as it flinches and cracks. Store warm in padded boxes.

Mutable Silver.hab: In the deep Churn of the Chaos Realm, silver that takes any shape. The tunnels there twist constantly and the walls move as the metal shifts.
Mutable Silver.how: Mine in a braced tunnel over three days and pour it into molds at once. Tunnels may collapse as the Churn moves. Store in shaped silver molds.

Stormglass.hab: On lightning-struck enchanted sand in the Plane of Air bordering Chaos, clear glass with blue veining. Fresh strike marks and charged air reveal it.
Stormglass.how: Dig it from the sand with insulated tools over a few hours between strikes. It crackles with charge. Store in wooden boxes lined with rubber.

Void Pearl.hab: In deep ocean trenches near planar rifts in the Chaos Realm, perfect black pearls in strange oysters. The water is dark, cold and crushing.
Void Pearl.how: Dive deep with water-breathing magic and pry oysters open over a day. Trench beasts guard the rifts. Store in black velvet in a sealed box.

Confusion Stone.hab: In Chaos realms where the air twists and turns, hazy swirling veins that hurt to stare at. Tunnels near them seem to loop and lead back on themselves.
Confusion Stone.how: Use a rope line and marked path to find your way back; cut with eyes half closed over two days. Long staring causes confusion. Store in covered boxes.

Crashstone.hab: Where shattered walls and impact craters litter the plains of Chaos, dense red-brown veins that ring like struck bells. Craters dot the ground above them.
Crashstone.how: Dig in crater beds with heavy picks over two days, wearing ear protection. It rings loudly when struck. Store in padded crates.

Depressionstone.hab: In the gloomy hollows of Chaos, heavy dull blue-gray veins that sink into the hand. The hollows are dim and cold, and visitors feel heavy and sad.
Depressionstone.how: Work in short shifts with cheerful companions over two days, as its gloom saps the will. Store in a closed box away from living spaces.

Diamondstone.hab: Deep in the unstable veins of Chaos, brilliant clear stone that splits light into colors. Tunnels shift and cave in, and the vein moves with the rock.
Diamondstone.how: Mine deep with braced tunnels and a diamond-tipped pick over a week. Cave-ins are a constant danger. Store in padded velvet cases.

Enchantmentstone.hab: In rune-laced ruins of Chaos, shimmering seams etched with tiny moving sigils. Old wards and stray magic still guard the ruins.
Enchantmentstone.how: Disarm old wards, then cut with a fine chisel over two days. Damaging the sigils breaks its magic. Store in warded cases.

Finitestone.hab: In the measured layers of Chaos, sharp-edged veins that never chip beyond their edges. These rare ordered bands stand out among the chaotic rock.
Finitestone.how: Cut along its natural edges with a straight saw over two days; it will not break any other way. Store in square-cut cases.

Halostone.hab: In Chaos where fallen divine beings once stood, ring-shaped seams of pale gold light that float a hair above the rock. The ground there glows faintly.
Halostone.how: Lift the ring gently with gloved hands after cutting it free over a day. It floats, so tie it down. Store in a closed box with a weight.

Hollowstone.hab: In Chaos caverns where something once lived and was drained, thin-walled grey shells that echo when tapped. The caverns feel empty and cold.
Hollowstone.how: Chip shells free with a soft hammer over a day; they crack easily. Something may still haunt the cavern. Store in padded boxes.

Identifystone.hab: In Chaos within shattered mirrors, flat polished silver seams that show the true face and runes of any creature. Shards of old mirrors litter the ground above.
Identifystone.how: Cut with a fine chisel over a day, avoiding your own reflection, which can unsettle the mind. Store face down in a velvet case.

Lichstone.hab: In Chaos crypt-rock, cold grey-green veins with a bright pinpoint pulsing like a heartbeat. Undead often guard the crypts above.
Lichstone.how: Clear the crypts first, then mine with blessed tools over three days. The undead may rise to defend it. Store in lead boxes with holy charms.

Mummystone.hab: In Chaos tombs, dry linen-colored seams wrapped in natural fibrous layers and smelling of resin and spices. Dry air and old curses fill the tombs.
Mummystone.how: Break tomb seals carefully and cut with a bronze chisel over two days, keeping it dry. Curses may afflict robbers. Store in sealed jars with spices.

Reality Shard.hab: At locations where reality fractured in the Chaos Realm, shards of crystallised existence. Space bends there, and things flicker in and out of being.
Reality Shard.how: Reach the fracture and pick up shards with warded tongs in minutes before they slip away. Being near too long unsettles your own reality. Store in warded boxes.

Recipestone.hab: In the Chaos Realm inside ruined alchemist halls and boiling mineral pools, layered seams covered with tiny script that rearranges into instructions.
Recipestone.how: Cool the pool or clear the hall, then peel layers apart with a thin blade over two days. Scalding water is a risk. Store flat between sheets.

Salvestone.hab: Waxy cream seams deep in Chaos bedrock where the Ointment Rune's power pools, often beside drifting herb-scented caverns; walls that sweat a thin, oily film mark a nearby vein.
Salvestone.how: Pry it loose with a bone or wooden wedge, since iron scrapes away the oil. Allow half a day per lump and store it wrapped in waxed linen inside lidded clay pots.

Scarstone.hab: Pale pink ridged veins beneath Chaos ground that tore open and healed shut, following the Scar Rune's pooled power; puckered, scar-like seams on cave walls betray it.
Scarstone.how: Chisel along the ridges, never across them, or the stone splits and loses its power. A day of patient work with a fine chisel; keep it in padded boxes.

Scornstone.hab: Cold black veins under ruined halls of Chaos exiles, where the Scorn Rune's power pools; air in those tunnels feels hostile and torches gutter for no reason.
Scornstone.how: Cut it with a cold iron pick while wearing gloves, as bare skin leaves miners bitter and quarrelsome for days. Takes a full shift; store in soot-blackened lead boxes.

Smellstone.hab: Brown earthy seams beneath Chaos beast lairs and old hunting trails, where the Smell Rune's power pools; a heavy animal reek in a tunnel means a vein is close.
Smellstone.how: Dig in pairs, one miner watching for the beasts its odor draws. A miner's pick and half a day frees a lump; seal it in oiled leather bags to hold the stench.

Thinstone.hab: Blade-thin grey slivers wedged in the tightest seams of Chaos bedrock, where the Thinner Rune's power pools; hairline cracks that whistle with drafts often hide one.
Thinstone.how: Draw it out with long jeweler's tongs and a thin wire saw, working by feel for hours. Wear thick gloves against its edges and sleeve each sliver in a reed tube.

Undinestone.hab: Damp blue veins below shifting Chaos springs and sea caves, where the Undine Rune's power pools; rock that weeps water in rippling patterns marks the seam.
Undinestone.how: Mine it at low tide or between spring surges, using a bronze pick that will not corrode. Keep it in jars of its own spring water or it cracks within a week.

Unfixed Amber.hab: Forms in drifting lumps along the border of the Unmade Core, where raw chaos briefly hardens around a single moment; shimmering, flickering air shows a lump is setting.
Unfixed Amber.how: Snatch it with warded silver tongs before the border shifts, often a wait of days. A Constitution save resists the backlash; store each lump in a sealed, rune-scribed glass case.

Unravel Ivy.hab: Creeps over the crumbling walls of ruined Chaos fortresses, loosening mortar and old wards as it climbs; collapsed arches and frayed banners mark where it thrives.
Unravel Ivy.how: Cut runners with a glass or stone sickle, since metal tools come apart in its grip. Never let it touch rope or spell scrolls; carry it in glazed clay jars.

Vampirestone.hab: Blood-red veins deep in the blood-soaked caverns of Chaos, where the Vampire Rune's power pools; lanterns dim strangely and the walls feel warm to the touch nearby.
Vampirestone.how: Mine only by sunstone light with a silver-edged pick, and bandage every cut, as the stone drinks spilled blood. A full day per lump; store in black velvet inside iron boxes.

Voidcrystal.hab: Grows in the absolute void between planes, clinging to drifting fragments where Chaos frays into nothing; a faint purple glint against total dark is the only sign.
Voidcrystal.how: Reach it by planar rift or spelljamming skiff, then cut it free with an adamant saw in silence. Expect weeks of travel; pack it in felt so it cannot touch force wards.

Possibility Bloom.hab: Blooms only in the calm heart of Chaos storms, rooted on spinning islands of torn earth; its shape changes for every eye, so seasoned gatherers find it by scent.
Possibility Bloom.how: Gatherers fly or ride the storm wall inward, then pick it blindfolded so it settles into one form. Seal it in an opaque box within the hour or it withers.

Rift Metal.hab: Dense veins deep underground around the Unmade Core, where Chaos bedrock is torn and reforged constantly; tunnels there twist and reshape themselves between shifts.
Rift Metal.how: Mine with adamant picks in short, warded shifts and brace each tunnel every hour, since the rock reshapes itself. Weeks of work per ingot's worth; store in rune-locked crates.

Storm Orichalcum.hab: Forms as glowing nuggets suspended in the eye of the endless Chaos tempest, hardened by constant lightning; crackling arcs between floating rocks show where it hangs.
Storm Orichalcum.how: Snare it with grounded copper nets from a storm-proof skiff, wearing rubber-lined gear. Store ingots far apart in insulated boxes, or lightning leaps between them and burns the hold.

Voidmetal.hab: Drifts as rare black shards in the empty Void between planes, near where Chaos tears through; spots where starlight vanishes for no reason betray a hidden shard.
Voidmetal.how: Only planar travelers retrieve it, hauling shards in with chains of anchored adamant over months. It cuts through force fields, so store it in plain lead boxes, never warded ones.

Fallstone.hab: Heavy dark chunks of debris littering ledges and slopes along the Fall, the great drop into the Abyss; easy to spot on any outcrop beside the descent.
Fallstone.how: Pick it up or lever it off ledges with a crowbar and rope; an hour fills a sack. Watch for falling debris overhead and haul it up with a block and tackle.

Trench Kelp.hab: Grows downward from the shallow shelves of the Abyssal sea, stretching toward the darkness rather than the light; dark rubbery fronds hang thick below shelf edges.
Trench Kelp.how: Wade or dive a few fathoms and cut it with a simple knife; an hour fills a basket. Dry it in the shade, since sunlight turns it brittle.

Brine Iron.hab: Black lumps of iron on the shallow shelves of the Abyssal sea, lying in salt mud a few fathoms down; rust-free dark nodules among the shells mark it.
Brine Iron.how: Dive with a basket and short pick, or dredge from a boat; a morning yields a sackful. Keep it in sea water until forging, as dry air slowly dulls it.

Lantern Algae.hab: Coats the walls of deep sea caves in the Abyss with glowing blue-green film, thickest where cold currents flow; the light is visible from far down a tunnel.
Lantern Algae.how: Scrape it with a flat blade into stoppered glass vials, a few hours per batch. Keep it wet and dark, or its glow fades within a day.

Lightless Moss.hab: Grows in thick dark mats on the walls between Abyss layers, where no light has ever reached; the stone feels soft and cold under the hand there.
Lightless Moss.how: Gather it by touch in total darkness, since lantern light makes it curl and spoil. Peel it with fingers into black cloth bags; an afternoon fills one.

Drowned Iron.hab: Water-soaked iron seams in the drowned layers of the Abyss, deep in flooded rock below the shelves; tunnels there run with constant salt seepage.
Drowned Iron.how: Dig with pumps running and a miner's pick, allowing two or three days per cartload. Shore every tunnel, as flooding is the main danger; keep the ore damp until smelting.

Pressure Lead.hab: Dense grey lumps on the floor of Abyssal seafloor trenches, crushed by the weight of deep water; the seabed sags around each heavy nodule.
Pressure Lead.how: Raise it by diving bell with chains and a winch, since one lump weighs as much as a man. A day per haul; never carry it by hand.

Umbral Kelp.hab: Long dark strands rising in drowned layers of the Abyss, rooted on flooded rock in still black water; strands so dark they swallow torchlight mark a bed.
Umbral Kelp.how: Dive with a water-breathing charm and a hooked blade, cutting long lengths over a day. Dry it in darkness and coil it like rope in tarred sacks.

Whisper Coral.hab: Grows in branching clusters on rock in the drowned layers of the Abyss, where currents murmur; faint voices heard underwater lead divers to a reef.
Whisper Coral.how: Snap branches with padded tongs while holding still, as loud noises shatter it. Takes a day's diving; wrap each branch in wet sponge for travel.

Deepglass.hab: Dark glassy seams buried in the stone walls between Abyss layers, formed under heavy pressure and darkness; cold black glints in the rock catch a lantern beam.
Deepglass.how: Mine slowly with a hammer and fine chisel, a full day per clean pane-sized piece. Cracks ruin its lens quality; pack it in straw-lined crates.

Drowning Lily.hab: Pale lilies blooming over flooded doorways and sunken courtyards in drowned Abyss ruins; floating white petals over a submerged ruin mark a patch.
Drowning Lily.how: Cut stems with a hooked knife from a boat, wearing gloves and a mask. A drop of sap in the mouth means a Constitution save against drowning; store sap in waxed vials.

Gulf Sargasso.hab: Golden weed drifting in endless rafts on the surface of the drowned gulf, far above the Abyss's depths; seabirds and golden gleams on the horizon mark a raft.
Gulf Sargasso.how: Rake it aboard from a boat over several hours, watching for predators nesting in the mats. Dry it on deck in the sun and bale it in netting.

Gulf Steel.hab: Blue-black crusts around hydrothermal vents deep in the drowned gulf, forged by boiling, mineral-rich water; plumes of black smoke rising from the seabed betray a vent.
Gulf Steel.how: Descend by diving bell with heat-warded suits and long hammers, breaking crust between eruptions. Expect a dangerous week per load; cool it slowly in brine barrels.

Sunken Silver.hab: Bright silver veins in the deep drowned layers of the Abyss, often near the bones of demons it once wounded; fiends avoid these flooded tunnels entirely.
Sunken Silver.how: Mine with warded pumps and silver-safe bronze tools over several days, guarding against demons who hunt miners. Store ingots in blessed oak chests.

Pearlweed.hab: Seagrass growing in meadows across the crushing pressure plains of the Abyss, far below any sunlight; tiny pearls glint in its stems under a lantern.
Pearlweed.how: Reach it in a reinforced diving bell, then cut stems carefully over hours. Rising too fast cracks the pearls and the diver; ascend slowly over a day.

Rim Obsidian.hab: Glassy black seams in the stone of the Rim, the scorched edge where the Abyss meets older fire; jagged black ridges and warm ground signal a deposit.
Rim Obsidian.how: Quarry with obsidian-safe bronze wedges and heavy gloves, as edges slice through leather. Several days per clean block; pack in sand-filled crates to stop chipping.

Abyss Pearl.hab: Grows inside giant shellfish on the leviathan grounds of the Abyss, where great beasts feed and nest; black shells among leviathan bones mark a bed.
Abyss Pearl.how: Dive in a warded bell while leviathans sleep, prying shells with an iron bar. Weeks of waiting and deadly risk; keep pearls in black silk pouches away from light.

Ballstone.hab: Smooth spheres sunk in the bedrock under old Abyss riverbeds, where the Ball Rune's power pools; perfectly round pebbles in the gravel above mark a vein.
Ballstone.how: Dig them out with a pick and cradle each sphere in a net, since they roll toward the nearest person. A day per sphere; store in padded cups with locked lids.

Betrayal Stone.hab: Green seams in Abyss mines where trusted tunnels collapse without warning, fed by the Betrayal Rune's pooled power; long-safe shafts that suddenly creak hide it.
Betrayal Stone.how: Brace every arm's length of tunnel and never mine alone; collapses come without warning. Crack each lump to check its black core, then store it in sealed iron.

Blackstone.hab: Light-drinking black seams in Abyss bedrock where the Black Rune's power pools; lanterns grow dim and torches shrink as miners approach a vein.
Blackstone.how: Mine by feel with a pick and a guide rope, as light fails near it. A full day per lump; wrap it in white cloth and store in lead boxes.

Bladestone.hab: Silver-grey slivers inside Abyss iron seams where the Blade Rune's power pools; tunnel walls bristling with sharp edges warn of a vein.
Bladestone.how: Cut it free with tongs and a fine chisel, wearing chain gloves. Allow a day; sheathe each piece in leather like a knife and pack separately.

Chaos Stone.hab: Clashing, shifting veins inside Abyss rifts where the Chaos Rune's power pools and the rock never holds the same shape for long.
Chaos Stone.how: Mine quickly in short shifts with warded picks before the rift reshapes the tunnel. Keep it in rune-bound iron boxes, or it slowly changes everything around it.

Clonestone.hab: Seams in Abyss chambers full of identical crystals, where the Clone Rune's power pools; rows of matching formations repeating down a tunnel betray it.
Clonestone.how: Never strike it hard, or it splits into copies that crowd the tunnel. Cut it gently with a wire saw over a day, and box each piece apart.

Cravenstone.hab: Pale grey crystals on crumbling ledges deep in Abyss tunnels, where the Cowardice Rune's power pools; workers near it feel a sudden urge to flee.
Cravenstone.how: Approach with a Wisdom save against the urge to run, roped to a partner. Chip it from the brittle ledge with a light hammer; store in a closed iron box.

Cross Stone.hab: Grey seams beneath ruined shrines sunk deep in the Abyss, where the Cross Rune's power pools; pale veins crossing at right angles show in the walls.
Cross Stone.how: Dig along the crossing point with a chisel and mallet, working through a day. Take care not to split the veins apart; wrap the stone in linen.

Cursestone.hab: Violet-black seams in the cursed pits of the Abyss, where the Curse Rune's power pools; withered bones and thread-like scars on the rock mark the spot.
Cursestone.how: Handle only with gloves and tongs, as bare touch can lay a curse. Cut it free over a day and store in salt-packed lead boxes behind wards.

Destructionstone.hab: Ember-cracked seams under shattered, ruined Abyss ground where the Destruction Rune's power pools; glowing cracks in broken rock show where a vein lies.
Destructionstone.how: Mine with damp padding and slow strikes, since rough blows make it burst. Takes a full day; carry it in water-cooled, iron-banded boxes.

Disassemblystone.hab: Interlocking-piece seams in the broken reaches of the Abyss, where the Disassembly Rune's power pools; rock there flakes and slides apart into puzzle pieces.
Disassemblystone.how: Collect each piece with tweezers and cloth trays, keeping them in order. Lose one and the stone fails; allow a day and store in a sectioned box.

Divinestone.hab: Gold-white veins deep in the Abyss where the Divine Rune's power pools, formed from sunken mortal beliefs; a faint hum like prayer rises from the stone.
Divinestone.how: Cut it with a blessed chisel over a full day while chanting softly to keep it calm. Store in a shrine-blessed chest away from profane things.

Drakestone.hab: Warm scaled seams under old dragon lairs sunk in the Abyss, where the Dragon Rune's power pools; scorched walls and old scales mark the site.
Drakestone.how: Mine in heat-proof gear and post guards, as drakes still nest near it. Pry it free with an iron bar over a day; store warm in sand-filled chests.

Egostone.hab: Glossy purple seams in grand mirrored caverns of the Abyss, where the Ego Rune's power pools; polished walls reflect only the viewer's own face.
Egostone.how: Mine blindfolded or with veils, as gazing into it causes vanity and stalled work. Cut it with a fine chisel over a day; wrap in cloth.

Emptystone.hab: Hollow grey shells embedded in the walls of vast empty Abyss caverns, where the Emptiness Rune's power pools; echoes die and air feels thin there.
Emptystone.how: Chip it free gently with a light hammer, since it shatters easily. A day's work; store in padded boxes, tied down so it does not float off.

Essencestone.hab: Ghostly seams deep in the Abyss where fallen gods and spirits sank and the Essence Rune's power pools; faint glows drift from the rock walls.
Essencestone.how: Mine with silver tools during the quietest hours, as spirits gather near it. Takes two days; store in blessed glass jars sealed with silver.

Fearstone.hab: Dark trembling seams in the dread pits of the Abyss, where the Fear Rune's power pools; miners near it hear whispered nightmares in the dark.
Fearstone.how: Pass a Wisdom save to approach and mine in short, roped shifts with a pick. Store wrapped in dark cloth in a closed box, never looked into.

Fillstone.hab: Packed, bursting-dense seams in tightly compressed rock of the Abyss, where the Fill Rune's power pools; tunnels feel crowded and air close near it.
Fillstone.how: Mine with a heavy pick and wedge, cutting small pieces over a day. Never cut too large or it cracks the tunnel; store in reinforced iron boxes.

Flightstone.hab: White-blue seams in the rock of wind-scoured Abyss peaks, where the Flight Rune's power pools; loose pebbles drifting upward betray a vein below.
Flightstone.how: Mine roped to the peak with a pick, netting each piece before it floats off. A day per lump in high winds; store in weighted, lidded boxes.

Flipstone.hab: Black-and-white seams in quiet Abyss hollows where the Flip Rune's power pools; rocks that seem to change color when glanced away from mark it.
Flipstone.how: Mine while a partner watches it constantly, or it flips and slips loose. Chip it out over a day; store in a box with a viewing slot.

Foestone.hab: Rust-red seams under old Abyss battlefields soaked in feuds, where the Foe Rune's power pools; rusted blades and old bones litter the ground above.
Foestone.how: Mine in groups and stay calm, as it stirs anger between workers. Cut it free with a pick over a day; store in an iron box away from rivals.

Gluttonystone.hab: Swollen crimson seams beneath Abyss feasting pits that were never emptied, where the Gluttony Rune's power pools; stale food smells drift through the tunnels.
Gluttonystone.how: Pry it out with a crowbar over a day and move it often, as it grows heavier the longer it is held. Store in strong iron boxes on carts.

Greedstone.hab: Gold-green seams under Abyss hoards where hoarders died clutching treasure, where the Greed Rune's power pools; old coins and skeletons mark the site.
Greedstone.how: Mine with honest partners and watch each other, as it tempts theft. Chisel it free over a day; store locked in iron with a counted seal.

Hourstone.hab: Clear crystal seams in still, silent pockets of the Abyss where the Time Rune's power pools; dust hangs in the air there, frozen mid-fall.
Hourstone.how: Mine with slow, careful strokes, as time stutters near it and work can take days. Keep it upright in a padded glass case so its grains stay calm.

Isolationstone.hab: Cold dark seams in empty corners of the Abyss, where the Isolation Rune's power pools; sound fades and companions seem far away near it.
Isolationstone.how: Mine on a guide rope with a bell tied to a partner, as miners lose track of each other. Takes a day; store it in a felt-lined box.

Knightstone.hab: Steel-grey crested seams beneath Abyssal fortresses where oaths were sworn and the knight Rune's power pools; broken shields and banners lie above.
Knightstone.how: Mine respectfully with a pick, only after swearing a short oath at the vein. Takes a day; store it in a polished chest with a crest.

Nethersea Wrack.hab: Black seaweed carpeting the lightless seafloor of the Abyss, deep below any light, surrounded by rotted bones and dissolving wrecks it has touched.
Nethersea Wrack.how: Harvest it in a warded diving bell with glass blades, since it rots metal and flesh. A dangerous week's work; store only in sealed glass jars.

Paradoxstone.hab: Shifting veins deep in Abyss rock where the Paradox Rune's power pools; walls feel both hot and cold, and tunnels seem both long and short.
Paradoxstone.how: Mine with patience and a calm mind over days, as its shape refuses to settle. Pass an Intelligence save to cut it; store in a mirror-lined box.

Rubstone.hab: Oily amber seams near Abyss healing pools and old ointment makers' cellars, where the Rub Rune's power pools; a warm sheen on the walls betrays it.
Rubstone.how: Chip it free with a bronze chisel and wipe the oil into jars to keep. Takes half a day; store the stone in waxed cloth.

Siphonstone.hab: Hollow dark green tubes in rock near old Abyss thieves' tunnels and drained wells, where the Siphon Rune's power pools; drained, dry stone marks the spot.
Siphonstone.how: Mine with gloves, as it slowly draws warmth and strength from the miner. Cut it free over a day; store capped at both ends in lead.

Smallerstone.hab: Tiny stones lodged in finger-wide cracks deep in Abyss rock, where the Smaller Rune's power pools; cracks that seem to shrink as you look hold them.
Smallerstone.how: Draw them out with jeweler's tweezers and a lens over hours of careful work. Store each in a marked glass vial so it is never lost.

Starlight Stone.hab: Pale blue glassy seams in cold Abyssal caverns open to distant stars, where the Starlight Rune's power pools; a faint shimmer shows even in total darkness.
Starlight Stone.how: Mine only at night when the stars are out, with a soft bronze chisel. Takes a night per shard; store in dark velvet so it keeps its glow.

Terraform Stone.hab: Banded strata seams where whole Abyssal landscapes have reshaped overnight and the Terraformation Rune's power pools; freshly shifted ground hides the vein.
Terraform Stone.how: Dig quickly with shovel and pick before the land shifts again, often within a day. Brace tunnels well and store pieces in sealed clay crates.

Touchstone.hab: Numbing black seams in dark, feeling-starved Abyss tunnels where the Touch Rune's power pools; hands go numb against the walls near a vein.
Touchstone.how: Mine with a pick and check hands often, as numbness hides cuts and injuries. A day per lump; store in a cloth-lined box.

Wishstone.hab: Prismatic veins that appear only by chance deep in Abyss rock where the Wish Rune's power pools, never twice in the same place; a rainbow glint in dark stone is the only sign.
Wishstone.how: Mine at once when found, with a fine chisel and steady hands, before it vanishes. One lucky miner in a lifetime finds it; store in a locked, warded jewel box.

Hungering Ore.hab: Dark red metal veins in the deepest known layers of the Abyss, where the rock seems to pulse; bloodless bones of lost miners lie near every vein.
Hungering Ore.how: Mine in heavy armor and never bleed near it, as it drinks blood and grows hungrier. Weeks of guarded work; store in blessed iron chests.

Abyss Adamant.hab: Inky nodules pressed into the lightless floor of the deepest Abyssal trench, under the whole weight of the Abyss; the cold there freezes divers solid.
Abyss Adamant.how: Only warded deep-bells reach it, cutting nodules with diamond tools over weeks while leviathans prowl. Raise it slowly and store it in frost-proof iron chests.

Edict Clover.hab: Grows in tidy patches across fields near minor Law anchors in the Inner Realm, where order is strong; every leaf has exactly three lobes.
Edict Clover.how: Pick it by hand with a small knife in an hour or two. Simply dry it flat in a press and store in paper envelopes.

Law Lichen.hab: Pale lichen spreading across the walls of Law-veins in the Inner Realm, where liquid Law seeps through the rock and leaves faint glowing traces.
Law Lichen.how: Scrape it with a bone knife into clay jars over an afternoon. Do not scrape the vein itself, as that weakens the Law and angers its keepers.

Oathgrass.hab: Stiff grass ringing old oath-stones in the Inner Realm, growing only where a vow was kept; bare ground beside a stone means an oath was broken.
Oathgrass.how: Cut it with a sickle after keeping a small promise, or it wilts at once. Takes an hour; tie it in bundles and dry it in the shade.

Rootstone.hab: Dense grey building stone found everywhere in the Inner Realm, in hills, cliffs and shallow quarries; ordinary outcrops show it plainly.
Rootstone.how: Quarry it with picks, wedges and a team over a few days. Heavy but safe work; stack the blocks under cover.

Edict Iron.hab: Iron seams along fault lines beneath Law anchors in the Inner Realm, stamped with tiny geometric marks; neat patterns on cracked rock betray a vein.
Edict Iron.how: Dig with picks and shovels over two or three days, following the faults. Stay clear of the anchors above; store it in crates.

Measure Moss.hab: Grows in exact squares across the walls of the Law of Measure in the Inner Realm, never crossing a line; neat green grids cover the stone.
Measure Moss.how: Cut along its square edges with a straight blade and a ruler. A few hours of careful work; ragged cuts kill it; store flat in boxes.

Stratum Iron.hab: Layered iron in the outer rock layers of the Inner Realm, banded like folded steel; neat stripes in a quarry wall show where it runs.
Stratum Iron.how: Mine with picks along the bands for two or three days. Do not cut across the layers or they split; store in sorted crates.

Veinwater.hab: Pools of liquid Law collecting in hollows along Inner Realm veins, clear and perfectly still; the surface never ripples, even when the ground shakes.
Veinwater.how: Ladle it into silver flasks with a measured cup, never spilling a drop. A few hours' work; spilled drops harden into useless stone.

Law-vein Ore.hab: Shining metal threaded through the Law-veins of the Inner Realm, carrying one Law within it; nearby rules grow faint when it is disturbed.
Law-vein Ore.how: Mine sparingly with permitted tools over several days, since each cut weakens a Law. Keepers demand licenses; store each lump tagged with its Law.

Anchor Root.hab: Thick roots running through the Root, the deep foundation of the Inner Realm, binding stone to stone; the ground above never trembles.
Anchor Root.how: Dig to the roots and saw a length free with a bronze saw over two days. Take only small lengths, or the ground above shifts; dry them slowly.

Axiom Gold.hab: Gold seams in lattice caves near the Law of Measure in the Inner Realm, its crystals growing in perfect ratios; geometric cave walls mark the deposit.
Axiom Gold.how: Mine with measured strokes and a set chisel over several days. Uneven cuts spoil its ratios; weigh and seal each nugget in a marked pouch.

Axiom Silver.hab: Silver seams in the stone of the Inner Realm's Anchor Halls, where rules are kept strictly; halls guarded by Law-keepers hide the best veins.
Axiom Silver.how: Mine only by permit from the Hall keepers, using approved tools over days. Breaking hall rules risks arrest; store in sealed silver boxes.

Verdict Hemlock.hab: Tall pale hemlock growing below the judgment halls of the Inner Realm, fed by water draining from the courts; condemned prisoners' cells often lie near.
Verdict Hemlock.how: Cut stems with gloves and a mask, as its sap is deadly poison. An afternoon's careful work; store in sealed, labeled vials.

Anchorstone.hab: Heavy stone forming the floors and pillars deep beneath the Inner Realm's Anchor Halls, held fast by Law; it cannot be lifted by magic.
Anchorstone.how: Quarry with heavy wedges and a team over a week, with a hall permit. Move blocks only by hand and pulley, since spells will not budge it.

Keystone Rose.hab: Grey roses growing from the keystone at the top of every Law anchor arch in the Inner Realm; a single bloom crowns each arch.
Keystone Rose.how: Climb the arch with ladders and rope and cut the bloom with silver shears. Never damage the keystone; takes a day and needs anchor-keeper approval.

Tribunal Steel.hab: Grey steel seams beneath the forges around the Inner Realm's Hall of Judgment, hardened by sworn oaths spoken above; lying near it softens the rock.
Tribunal Steel.how: Mine under oath with a sworn crew, as liars weaken the metal. A week of guarded work with tribunal permits; store in oak chests sealed by judges.

Actionstone.hab: Humming grey veins in Inner Realm bedrock where the Action Rune's power pools; loose pebbles and dust never quite settle near the seam.
Actionstone.how: Mine with quick, steady strokes over a day, since it shifts if left still. Store it in a tight padded box to stop it rattling loose.

Addstone.hab: Pale layered veins in the Inner Realm where the Add Rune's power pools, each seam slightly thicker than the last; overgrown layers mark the vein.
Addstone.how: Mine with a chisel, peeling layers carefully over a day. Store it in an oversized box, since it keeps adding thin layers.

Bracestone.hab: Flat rooted seams in Inner Realm cliffs that weather storms unmoved, where the Brace Rune's power pools; unbroken cliff faces mark the vein.
Bracestone.how: Cut it free with heavy wedges and a team over two days, as it resists moving. Store it flat on a sturdy pallet.

Cohesion Stone.hab: Unbreakable seams in Inner Realm rock where everything holds together and the Cohesion Rune's power pools; walls there never crack.
Cohesion Stone.how: Cut around it, never through it, with picks over several days, since it will not break. Lift it whole and store on a wooden pallet.

Cometstone.hab: Blazing seams beneath shooting-star craters in the Inner Realm, where the Comet Rune's power pools; scorched rings and glowing dust mark impact sites.
Cometstone.how: Dig into the crater bed with heat-proof gloves over a day. It flares when struck; store it in a fireproof, sand-filled box.

Cyclestone.hab: Ring-shaped seams among the deep roots of the Inner Realm, where the Cycle of Life Rune's power pools; fresh sprouts and old bones lie side by side.
Cyclestone.how: Dig gently around the roots with a trowel over a day, never cutting a living root. Store the ring upright so it can keep turning.

Deletionstone.hab: Blank white gaps in Inner Realm rock where the Deletion Rune's power pools; it looks like a hole cut out of the world.
Deletionstone.how: Cut around it with a long chisel over a day, never touching it bare-handed, as skin goes numb. Store in a clearly labeled box so it is not lost.

Dexteritystone.hab: Green glinting seams on narrow ledges of the Inner Realm, where the Dexterity Rune's power pools; quick flashes of green on cliff faces mark it.
Dexteritystone.how: Climb with rope and a nimble partner, catching it in a net as it slips free. A day per piece; store in a drawstring pouch.

Differencestone.hab: Black-and-white seams in stark layers of Inner Realm rock where the Difference Rune's power pools; sharp lines split the stone into two colors.
Differencestone.how: Cut along the seam's edge with a fine chisel over a day, never mixing the halves. Store each piece in a split box.

Empathystone.hab: Pink seams under quiet groves of the Inner Realm where the Empathy Rune's power pools; workers there feel each other's moods strongly.
Empathystone.how: Mine calmly in a cheerful group with a gentle chisel over a day, since anger cracks it. Store wrapped in soft wool.

Energystone.hab: Buzzing white-blue seams in charged Inner Realm caves where the Energy Rune's power pools; hair stands on end and sparks jump from tools.
Energystone.how: Mine with wooden-handled picks and rubber gloves, as shocks hurt. A day's work; store in insulated clay jars far from metal.

Fextstone.hab: Blotchy seams under Inner Realm graves where the Fext Rune's power pools; grave soil there shifts color between living and dead hues.
Fextstone.how: Mine at dawn with blessed tools, as the restless dead stir near it. Takes a day; store in a sealed iron box with salt.

Fleshstone.hab: Warm rose-and-ivory seams beneath Inner Realm barrows where the dead were laid unburned, where the Flesh Rune's power pools; the rock gives under the thumb.
Fleshstone.how: Cut it with a sharp bronze knife, not a pick, over a day. It bruises if handled roughly; store wrapped in damp cloth.

Formation Stone.hab: Faceted seams in Inner Realm caverns where several veins meet and the Formations Rune's power pools; colored patterns shift on the walls.
Formation Stone.how: Mine with a fine chisel, cutting along facets over a day. Breaking a facet ruins its patterns; store in a fitted wooden case.

Ghaststone.hab: Rotten-smelling green-black seams under Inner Realm graveyards on poisoned ground, where the Ghast Rune's power pools; dead grass and a foul stench mark it.
Ghaststone.how: Wear a mask and gloves and mine over a day, as the smell causes sickness. Store in a sealed lead box; the stench never fades.

Ghoulstone.hab: Mottled grey seams beneath Inner Realm crypts where bodies lay uneaten, where the Ghoul Rune's power pools; gnaw marks and bones line the tunnel.
Ghoulstone.how: Mine with guards against ghouls drawn to it, over a day's work. Bandage every cut and store it in a sealed iron box.

Keystone Platinum.hab: Platinum seams in the deep root vaults beneath the Inner Realm's Law anchors, where Law holds firmest; vault walls shine and resist all spells.
Keystone Platinum.how: Mine with permission and ward-safe tools over two weeks, under anchor-keeper watch. Take too much and the anchor weakens; store in sealed vaults.

Miraclestone.hab: Radiant golden seams in Inner Realm rock where the Miracle Rune's power pools; holy symbols nearby shine on their own and despair feels lighter.
Miraclestone.how: Mine with prayer and blessed chisels over a day, as it dims for the greedy. Store it in a shrine-blessed box.

Necrostone.hab: Grey-violet seams beneath Inner Realm graveyards where the Necromancy Rune's power pools; small bones shift and cold creeps through the tunnels.
Necrostone.how: Mine with a priest on watch, as bones rise near it. A day of guarded work; store in a salt-packed iron box.

Paststone.hab: Sepia seams in Inner Realm rock where the Past Rune's power pools; faded images of old events flicker on the walls.
Paststone.how: Mine gently with a fine chisel over a day, without staring at its visions. Store it wrapped in cloth so its images rest.

Pollenstone.hab: Soft yellow seams in Inner Realm rock where the Pollination Rune's power pools; flowers bloom in the tunnels wherever its dust falls.
Pollenstone.how: Mine with a soft brush and chisel over a day, catching the pollen in cloth. Store in a sealed jar so its dust does not spread.

Pure Law Crystal.hab: Clear crystals growing at junctions where several Inner Realm Law-veins meet; perfectly straight light beams cross the caverns there.
Pure Law Crystal.how: Cut with precise silver tools over several days, with keeper permits. A crooked cut shatters it; store in a velvet-lined case.

Reboundstone.hab: Rubbery blue seams wedged in Inner Realm canyon walls where every sound echoes three times and the Rebound Rune's power pools.
Reboundstone.how: Pry it out with a padded wedge over a day; hammers bounce back at the miner. Store in a soft-lined box.

Repeatstone.hab: Banded orange seams in Inner Realm caves where every echo and footstep repeats a heartbeat later, fed by the Repeat Rune's pooled power.
Repeatstone.how: Mine with single, deliberate strokes over a day, as each blow repeats. Store in a closed box to quiet its looping patterns.

Rulestone.hab: Square slate seams beneath the halls of ancient councils and guild houses in the Inner Realm, where the Rules Rune's power pools; ruled lines mark the walls.
Rulestone.how: Mine strictly by guild rules, using approved tools over a day. Break a rule and it cracks; store in a flat, marked crate.

Sentience Stone.hab: Milky seams in Inner Realm rock where the Sentience Rune's power pools, near old tools and statues that began to think; moving shapes stir inside it.
Sentience Stone.how: Mine politely and gently over a day, as it may resist being taken. Store it in a box with air holes and speak kindly to it.

Singularity Stone.hab: Tiny black stones at the bottom of collapsed starfall craters in the Inner Realm, where the Singularity Rune's power pools; dust and light drain toward them.
Singularity Stone.how: Dig carefully with long tongs over a day, as it drags in tools and sound. Store in a heavy lead box bolted shut.

Steelstone.hab: Blue-grey silver-banded veins in iron-choked rock deep in the Inner Realm, where the Steel Rune's power pools; tools blunt fast near it.
Steelstone.how: Mine with adamant-tipped picks over two days, as it breaks lesser tools. Store in iron-banded crates.

Tastestone.hab: Salt-white crystals around mineral springs in the Inner Realm, where the Taste Rune's power pools; spring water there tastes ever-changing.
Tastestone.how: Chip it from spring edges with a bronze chisel over half a day. Keep it dry and store in glass jars away from food.

Trainingstone.hab: Scarred seams beneath Inner Realm practice yards and dueling grounds, where the Training Rune's power pools; worn ground and chipped rock mark it.
Trainingstone.how: Mine with hard, steady blows over two days, as it toughens each strike. Store in a crate; it gets harder the more it is hit.

Transmute Stone.hab: Quicksilver seams beneath alchemists' deep labs in the Inner Realm, where the Transmutation Rune's power pools; metals there slowly change.
Transmute Stone.how: Mine with glass tools over a day, as metal tools change near it. Store in a sealed glass jar away from coins.

Uncertain Stone.hab: Smoke-grey seams in shifting Inner Realm caves no map agrees on, where the Uncertain Rune's power pools; tunnels change length as you walk.
Uncertain Stone.how: Mine by feel with a guide rope, as eyes cannot fix its edges. Takes days to find again; store in a labeled sealed box.

Widestone.hab: Broad flat seams under the wide plains of the Inner Realm, where the Wider Rune's power pools; the ground there stretches strangely flat.
Widestone.how: Dig it out with shovels and wedges over a day, lifting it with a team. Store standing on edge, as it spreads when laid down.

Keystone.hab: Pale load-bearing stone deep in the Root, the foundation beneath the Inner Realm, holding up whole regions; quakes never touch the rock around it.
Keystone.how: Quarry tiny blocks only, with Law-keeper permission and a team, over weeks. Take too much and land above collapses; store in braced crates.

Lawbinder Ivy.hab: Iron-grey ivy climbing the walls of the Inner Realm's great anchors, pinning stone and intruders in place by Law; trapped birds and stilled dust mark it.
Lawbinder Ivy.how: Cut it with Law-warded shears over days, never letting it touch you, or you are pinned in place. Store coiled in iron chains.

Anchor Adamant.hab: Raw adamant in bedrock pinned beneath the greatest Laws of the Inner Realm, deeper than almost any miner goes; no spell or quake moves the rock there.
Anchor Adamant.how: Only months of hand-mining with adamant tools under Law-keeper oath can free it, as magic fails. Moved only by hand and pulley; store in place-bound vaults.

Coreheart Crystal.hab: Deep crystals at the very heart of the Root beneath the Inner Realm, glowing with stored Law; guardians and ancient wards surround every cluster.
Coreheart Crystal.how: Reach it through weeks of guarded tunnels and cut it with diamond tools under keeper oath. A wrong cut kills the miner; store in warded vaults.

Judgment Lotus.hab: White lotus floating in the scales of the great tribunal pools in the Inner Realm, where the highest judgments are weighed; only the just can approach.
Judgment Lotus.how: Pick it only after a trial before the tribunal, with clean hands and a silver blade. Liars burn at its touch; store in a pool-water jar.

Starmoss.hab: Grows on the cliffs of outer islands in the Outer Realm, sprinkled with points of light like a night sky; easy to spot from passing ships.
Starmoss.how: Climb with rope and scrape it into a bag with a knife over an hour or two. Store dry in a dark tin.

Astral Bronze.hab: Silvery bronze seams in drifting islands just past the Astral, rising slightly from the rock; floating pebbles near an island's edge mark it.
Astral Bronze.how: Mine with ordinary picks over a day or two, tying each piece down before it drifts off. Store in weighted crates.

Comet Fern.hab: Ferns rooting along comet trails through the Outer Realm, their silver tails pointing away from the nearest star; bright streaks mark a trail.
Comet Fern.how: Fly or sail along the trail and cut fronds with a knife over a few hours. Dry them flat in a dark press.

Farstone.hab: Cold light stone found everywhere in the Outer Realm, in cliffs, islands and quarries; pale, chilly outcrops show it clearly.
Farstone.how: Quarry with picks and wedges over a day or two. Light and easy to move; stack blocks under cover.

Unlight Moss.hab: Cold dark moss covering the starless plains of the Outer Realm, where no stars shine; the ground feels chilly and soft underfoot.
Unlight Moss.how: Gather it by touch in darkness with a small knife over an afternoon. Light makes it curl; store in black cloth bags.

Astral Dandelion.hab: Dandelions growing in the astral meadows of the Outer Realm, their seeds drifting between islands; puffs of white floating between islands mark a meadow.
Astral Dandelion.how: Pick the clocks gently with cupped hands into a jar on still days. Takes an afternoon; one breeze scatters them.

Horizon Ore.hab: Long thin seams at the edges of the Outer Realm plains, stretching toward the horizon; rock there seems to run on forever.
Horizon Ore.how: Mine with picks along the seam over two or three days. Store in long crates, as it does not like to be cut short.

Star-Iron.hab: Pitted meteoric iron buried in impact craters on outer islands of the Outer Realm, cold and faintly drawn to magic; scorched crater rims mark it.
Star-Iron.how: Dig into the crater bed with picks over two or three days. Keep spellcasters back, as it tugs at magic; store in lead-lined crates.

Nebula Poppy.hab: Poppies of shifting purple and blue light in the nebula fields of the Outer Realm, among glowing gas clouds; colored glow marks a patch.
Nebula Poppy.how: Fly into the field with masks against the haze and cut flowers with a silver knife over a day. Store in dark glass.

Moonsteel.hab: Pale steel seams in broken moons orbiting the far shore of the Outer Realm; it shines brightest when the moons wax.
Moonsteel.how: Sail to the moons and mine only during a full phase, when the metal is strongest. A week's trip; store in moonlit crates.

Starless Metal.hab: Cold dark metal seams beneath the starless plains of the Outer Realm, where no light reaches; frosted rock marks a vein.
Starless Metal.how: Mine in cold-proof gear over several days. It must be forged cold; store in insulated crates.

Cold Star Shard.hab: Icy shards scattered in dead star fields of the Outer Realm, where old stars burned out; frost and dim light glow around them.
Cold Star Shard.how: Collect with insulated tongs over days, as bare touch freezes skin. Store in frost-proof boxes.

Farshore Electrum.hab: Gold-silver grains washed up on beaches at the edge of known space in the Outer Realm; glittering sand marks rich beds.
Farshore Electrum.how: Pan the sand over several days, watching for strange tides. Store grains in sealed pouches.

Horizon Orchid.hab: Orchids growing at the far horizon of the Outer Realm, always seeming farther away than they are; travelers chase them for days.
Horizon Orchid.how: Walk toward it with eyes closed, counting steps, then cut it with a knife. Takes days; store in a closed glass box.

Burnstone.hab: Red-orange seams in Outer Realm rock where the Metabolism Rune's power pools; walls there feel warm and pulse like a heartbeat.
Burnstone.how: Mine with steady, calm strokes, since exertion makes it hot enough to burn. A day's work; store in a cool stone box.

Causality Stone.hab: Clear threaded seams in Outer Realm vaults where cause and effect are carved in rock, where the Causality Rune's power pools.
Causality Stone.how: Mine with planned strokes over two days, as every blow echoes later. Store in a padded box, handled in order.

Codestone.hab: Symbol-etched seams beneath Outer Realm temples where oaths were sworn, where the Code Rune's power pools; carved symbols never wear away there.
Codestone.how: Mine with temple permission and a fine chisel over a day, without scratching its symbols. Store in a cloth-lined box.

Constitution Stone.hab: Dense grey seams in Outer Realm mountains that have outlasted countless storms, where the Constitution Rune's power pools; unbroken peaks mark it.
Constitution Stone.how: Mine with adamant picks over days, as it barely chips. Store on sturdy pallets.

Corpsestone.hab: Cold grey seams beneath Outer Realm battlefields where the dead were left to rot, where the Corpse Rune's power pools; decay fouls the air.
Corpsestone.how: Mine in masks with a priest on watch over a day, as the dead stir. Store in a sealed lead box.

Cosmicstone.hab: Dark star-flecked stones floating in Outer Realm skies where the universe is closest and the Cosmic Rune's power pools; moving starlight marks them.
Cosmicstone.how: Reach them by flying ship and net them with silver mesh over days. Store in a dark velvet box so the stars stay calm.

Dartstone.hab: Slim blue arrowhead seams beneath the plains of the Outer Realm, where the Dart Rune's power pools; pieces scattered above point toward people.
Dartstone.how: Dig them with gloves and keep them pointed away, as they quiver toward targets. Takes half a day; store point-down in a quiver.

Far-tide Glass.hab: Clear glass formed by far-tides lapping planar shores of the Outer Realm; it washes up in smooth panes at low tide.
Far-tide Glass.how: Gather at low tide with padded gloves before the tide returns. Takes days; store in straw-lined crates.

Farshore Amber.hab: Golden sap seeping from trees in farshore forests of the Outer Realm; trapped insects and leaves in glowing drips mark rich trees.
Farshore Amber.how: Tap trees with a spout and collect sap in jars over days. Never touch it bare, as it preserves skin; store sealed.

Friendstone.hab: Warm amber seams beneath Outer Realm groves where travelers swore oaths of kinship, where the Friend Rune's power pools.
Friendstone.how: Mine in pairs only, with two hands on the chisel, over a day. Store in a shared box.

Girlstone.hab: Pearl-pink and yellow seams beneath Outer Realm meadows where young spirits play, where the Girl Rune's power pools.
Girlstone.how: Mine gently with a light chisel over a day, leaving small gifts for the spirits. Store in a soft-lined box.

Gradestone.hab: Banded seams beneath Outer Realm testing grounds, each band deeper than the last, where the Grade Rune's power pools.
Gradestone.how: Mine band by band with a chisel over two days, keeping the layers in order. Store in a stacked box.

Gravitystone.hab: Dense black seams in Outer Realm craters where the ground bends inward, where the Gravity Rune's power pools; dust spirals into the crater.
Gravitystone.how: Dig with braced picks over two days, lifting with pulleys, since it weighs far more than it looks. Store in reinforced crates.

Hailstone.hab: Frosty white seams in the mountains beneath Outer Realm cloudbanks, where the Hail Rune's power pools; snow falls there year round.
Hailstone.how: Climb with cold-proof gear and chisel it free over a day. It never melts; store in a dry box.

Ignis Stone.hab: Seams in the walls of Outer Realm volcanic chasms, deep where the Ignis Rune's power pools; look for rock blackened in rings and a red-gold flicker behind thin crust.
Ignis Stone.how: Cut out with a cold-iron chisel on a long haft over two or three days, wearing fire-warded gloves; set it in stone-lined boxes, never wood or cloth, which it slowly chars.

Improvementstone.hab: Beneath old Outer Realm training grounds trodden for generations, in green-gold banded veins where the Improvement Rune pools; the packed earth above rings faintly with remembered drills.
Improvementstone.how: Dig down through the drill yard and split out the bands along their layers with a broad wedge; take only whole bands, as broken ones stop growing. Two days of patient work.

Inanestone.hab: Under Outer Realm ruins where something was undone, in dull black seams where the Inane Rune pools; the ground above feels hollow and footsteps make no echo.
